ad48e1a9d0dc08b52a5c.description:
Job Description
  
  
Global Commercial & Launch Excellence | US Launch Excellence | Oncology Launches
  
Shape launch strategy into coordinated action. Build clarity across complex workstreams. Help launch teams anticipate what is next and deliver with excellence.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Our Human Health business is preparing for an important period of innovation and potential launches. The Associate Director, US Launch Excellence will serve as the commercial launch partner in the US Oncology business unit, with primary focus on launches in the hematology portfolio.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of strategy, planning and execution. You will partner with marketing leadership and cross-functional teams to create integrated launch plans, connect decisions and dependencies across workstreams, strengthen readiness and help teams move from strategy to coordinated action. Success requires strategic judgment, disciplined orchestration and the ability to influence without direct authority.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Lead integrated launch planning and readiness
  
  

* Partner with marketing leadership and launch teams to translate brand, customer and go-to-market strategy into integrated, adaptable launch plans with clear outcomes, milestones, dependencies and ownership.
* Orchestrate readiness across core and extended launch workstreams, connecting functional plans and ensuring the team sees the full launch picture rather than isolated activities.
* Establish transparent mechanisms to assess progress, surface gaps and support timely decisions through launch plans, readiness indicators, dashboards and key performance indicators.
* Support pre-launch measurement, launch monitoring and post-launch hypercare to enable rapid learning and course correction.

Anticipate risk and improve decision quality
  
  

* Proactively identify and interrogate critical paths, risks, assumptions and cross-functional dependencies; facilitate mitigation, trade-off and escalation discussions before issues affect readiness.
* Lead scenario planning and prioritization to focus team attention and resources on the activities most critical to launch success.
* Bring an outside-in and enterprise perspective, applying excellence practices while tailoring the approach to the asset, market, and oncology customer ecosystem.

Operate as a strategic launch partner
  
  

* Serve as a trusted thought partner and launch excellence subject matter expert who asks the right questions, challenges constructively and engages the right functional experts.
* Design and facilitate effective core and extended launch team meetings and other readiness forums that drive alignment, decisions, accountability and follow-through.
* Build strong partnerships across Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Support, Data & Analytics, Digital, Field and Learning & Development, as well as Global teams and Centers of Excellence.
* Help clarify global-to-US inputs, ownership and handoffs so US teams can build on enterprise work and avoid unnecessary duplication.

Advance launch excellence capabilities
  
  

* Capture and apply launch learnings, reusable practices and knowledge to strengthen future Oncology and US Human Health launches.
* Improve launch ways of working across people, process and technology, including thoughtful use of digital and AI-enabled capabilities within company policies.
* Contribute to the evolution of the launch planner from primarily program coordination toward a strategic partner who strengthens team thinking, integration and execution.

What You Bring
  
  
**Required Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, General Management, Biotechnology or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of commercial experience in the biopharmaceutical, pharmaceutical, biotechnology or life sciences consulting industry, including experience in marketing, sales, strategy and planning, commercial operations or a related function.
* Demonstrated ability to develop strategy and translate it into executable plans across a broad, cross-functional stakeholder group in a matrixed organization.
* Strong program and project management capabilities, including managing multiple complex initiatives, milestones, risks and interdependencies simultaneously.
* Proven ability to influence without direct authority, build commitment and drive accountability across functions and organizational levels.
* Excellent written, verbal, facilitation and presentation skills, including the ability to synthesize complexity and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel as needed for business meetings and conferences.
* Ability to meet the on-site expectations defined for the role and location in the approved requisition.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience leading or materially supporting a branded new product, indication or commercial program launch in the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry.
* Oncology experience, including familiarity with complex patient, provider, access and account pathways.
* Experience across integrated go-to-market planning, patient support, market access, field readiness, customer experience or launch measurement.
* Demonstrated use of data and insights to inform priorities, readiness decisions, KPIs and performance optimization.
* Experience with scenario planning, Agile ways of working, launch governance, knowledge management or post-launch hypercare.
* Experience working across global and market teams or in an alliance environment.

**Critical Skills and Competencies:**  

* Strategic acumen: Connects market, customer and enterprise context to the few priorities that matter most, then translates strategy into action.
* Launch orchestration: Creates structure across complex workstreams while maintaining focus on integration, outcomes and critical dependencies.
* Constructive challenge: Uses sound judgment and thoughtful questions to test assumptions, expose gaps and improve decisions.
* Stakeholder leadership: Builds trust, aligns perspectives and mobilizes teams through influence rather than authority.
* Risk and systems thinking: Anticipates downstream implications, understands interdependencies and helps teams act early.
* Executive communication: Synthesizes complex information into clear, concise and decision-oriented narratives.
* Learning agility: Adapts quickly, seeks outside-in perspectives and applies lessons across launches.
* Ownership and follow-through: Creates clarity, maintains momentum and ensures decisions translate into accountable action.

Why This Role Matters
  
You will have the opportunity to shape readiness for a growing Oncology pipeline, partner with leaders across the enterprise and help evolve how launch excellence is delivered. The role offers broad exposure, meaningful strategic influence and the chance to build capabilities that extend beyond a single asset or launch.
  
  
**Required Skills:**  
Adaptability, Adaptability, Agile Project Management, Building Trust, Business Agility, Business Management, Commercial Operations Management, Data-Driven Decision Making, Developing Proposals, Employee Performance Evaluations, Environmental Scanning, Executive Leadership, Executive Reports, Feasibility Studies, Financial Acumen, Goal Setting, Influencing Skills, Influencing Without Authority, Learning Agility, Market Research, Pharmaceutical Market, Portfolio Management, Product Ownership, Progress Monitoring, Project Management {+ 8 more}

Lehigh University's Information Technology Services (ITS) division keeps a complex, research-driven campus connected and the people who coordinate that work behind the scenes make all the difference. As Project and Communications Coordinator, you'll be the organizational backbone for ITS initiatives, ensuring multi-year technology implementations stay on track and that every stakeholder hears a clear, consistent message along the way.

Position Number: S78550

This position is a Grade: 7 - 37.5 with an approximate salary range of $37,190-$44,640 and is subject to change based on experience, skills and qualifications.

**What You'll Own**

* Maintain project plans, timelines, and milestone tracking across ITS initiatives, including multi-year technology implementations
* Follow up with project stakeholders between meetings to sustain momentum and keep deliverables on course
* Coordinate scheduling, logistics, and documentation for project meetings, and prepare status reports for ITS leadership
* Draft and distribute ITS communications to departmental and university stakeholders in a clear, consistent voice
* Partner with the Director of Marketing and Communications (Finance & Administration) to standardize messaging formats and maintain a communications calendar

* Familiarity with project management tools and higher education communications practices preferred
* Demonstrated experience coordinating projects or programs, with an ability to manage competing timelines independently
* Strong written communication skills and a track record of producing clear, audience-appropriate content
* Proficiency with project tracking tools and standard office productivity software

Bethlehem's revitalized arts and dining scene makes the location an added bonus. Lehigh University is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate. 01607f14ec210fcf3947.description:
**Family-owned company looking for Purchasing & Inventory Coordinator.**

Position Summary

The Purchasing & Inventory Coordinator is responsible for coordinating inventory replenishment, managing vendor relationships, maintaining ERP data integrity, supporting house account management, and ensuring efficient purchasing operations. This role requires a combination of meticulous coordination and data management, proactive problem-solving and research, and strong vendor relationship management.

A demonstrated passion for the animal nutrition industry, coupled with a commitment to delivering excellent service, is required to successfully support both internal and external customers while contributing to the company’s overall growth and profitability.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Inventory Replenishment & Purchasing

* Monitor inventory to ensure products are available to meet customer demand.
* Place weekly or periodic purchase orders with assigned vendors as required.
* Review inventory levels, sales trends, and forecasts to identify replenishment needs.
* Coordinate with vendors to confirm product availability and expected delivery dates.
* Manage open purchase orders and follow up on outstanding shipments.
* Resolve discrepancies related to purchase orders, quantities, pricing, and receipts.
* Monitor backorders and communicate potential supply disruptions to management and sales staff.
* Assist in developing purchasing strategies that optimize inventory levels and cash flow.

Developing & Nurturing Vendor Relationships

* Establish and maintain positive, professional relationships with assigned vendors.
* Communicate regularly with vendors regarding product availability, pricing, lead times, and promotions.
* Monitor vendor promotions and keep the team informed of their status and opportunities.
* Assist in negotiating favorable pricing, terms, and freight arrangements when appropriate.
* Research and evaluate new vendors and product opportunities.
* Maintain vendor sample accounts, including bag replacements, samples, credits, and ISOs.
* Ensure vendor information is current and accurately maintained within company systems.

Maintaining ERP / Inventory Control

* Ensure ERP data accuracy by maintaining current records and removing obsolete records in a timely manner.
* Monitor and update pricing based on formulations and ensure pricing changes are entered into the ERP system promptly.
* Create and maintain new item, vendor, and pricing records.
* Review inventory transactions and investigate discrepancies.
* Collaborate with warehouse and receiving personnel to ensure inventory accuracy.
* Understand inbound freight costs, collaborate with Receiving, and update freight costs in the ERP system promptly.
* Generate and analyze inventory and purchasing reports as needed.
* Support cycle count and physical inventory processes.

Managing Assigned House Accounts

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts and provide excellent customer service.
* Process orders accurately and efficiently.
* Assist customers with product information, pricing, and availability.
* Resolve customer concerns and coordinate solutions internally when necessary.
* Maintain account records and ensure customer information remains current.
* Collaborate with sales and operations teams to support account growth and retention.

Team Coordination & Operational Support

* Manage incoming freight by reviewing purchase order requirements and collaborating with transportation carriers to ensure on-time pickups and deliveries.
* Coordinate with warehouse, receiving, and sales teams to support business needs.
* Maintain purchasing records, procedures, deadlines, and vendor-specific contact information to facilitate efficient ordering processes and job coverage during employee absences.
* Provide backup support for purchasing and inventory-related activities as needed.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance purchasing and inventory processes.
* Assist with special projects and other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Education & Experience

* Associate's or bachelor's degree preferred, or a minimum of five years of relevant purchasing, inventory, or supply chain experience.
* Experience with inventory management, purchasing, or supply chain operations preferred.
* Experience working within an ERP system strongly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Commitment to accuracy, professionalism, and customer service.
* Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

Critical Working Relationships

Internal Relationships

* CFO
* Logistics Manager
* Sales Team
* Customer Service Team
* Receiving Team
* Warehouse Team
* Operations Team

External Relationships

* Vendors and Suppliers
* Transportation Carriers
* Assigned House Accounts
* Product Representatives

Physical Requirements

* Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to use standard office equipment, including computers, phones, and printers.
* Ability to occasionally visit warehouse and receiving areas.

Success Measures

A successful Purchasing & Inventory Coordinator will:

* Maintain product availability while minimizing excess inventory.
* Build and sustain strong vendor relationships.
* Ensure ERP records remain accurate and up to date.
* Support customer satisfaction through effective account management.
* Coordinate purchasing and logistics activities efficiently.
* Contribute to operational improvements and cost-saving initiatives.
* Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, and commitment to the company's mission and values.

This position plays a key role in ensuring efficient purchasing operations, inventory accuracy, vendor performance, and customer satisfaction while supporting the continued growth of the organization.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $65,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

0f8e4cca588ecf4e3b4b.title: Construction Project Operations Coordinator
0f8e4cca588ecf4e3b4b.description:
At Jukebox Health, our mission is to empower everyone to live safer, healthier, more independent lives at home. We partner with health plans to make homes safer and more accessible for older adults and high-needs populations. We achieve this by combining technology with networks of clinicians, suppliers, and installers to deliver personalized home modifications and environmental supports nationwide. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs, Jukebox Health is a fast growing healthcare services company backed by top venture capital firms like Valtruis and The Home Depot.

We are seeking a Project Operations Coordinator to serve as the operational backbone for a portfolio of home modification projects within their assigned region. You'll be the primary point of contact for Jukebox's service provider network, helping move home modification projects from bid through completion. You'll spend much of your day communicating with service providers - scheduling work, following up on bids, checking in on active projects, collecting closeout documentation, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

You'll work closely with our Project Managers and Member Engagement team to surface risks early, resolve issues quickly, and create a smooth experience for our service providers and members. You'll also support the operational side of the business through order entry, claims processing, and maintaining accurate project records in our CRM.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on a high volume of work, is a resourceful problem solver who takes initiative, and enjoys building relationships.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Service Provider Coordination**

* Answer inbound calls and emails, handle routine questions, and escalate to the Project Manager when needed
* Follow up with service providers to get bids submitted
* Schedule and confirm project start dates
* Check in on active projects and flag delays or risks early
* Make sure providers understand expectations, timelines, and documentation requirements
* Build trusted relationships with our network to keep providers responsive, engaged, and eager to take on our projects

**Project Throughput**

* Keep a high volume of active projects moving through each stage without letting them stall
* Work daily from operational queues to determine priorities and next actions
* Send reminders ahead of key milestones and deadlines

**Documentation, Claims & Administration**

* Collect closeout documents, photos, and required forms, and follow up until everything is complete and accurate
* Assist with claims entry and processing
* Enter and maintain project orders accurately
* Review records for completeness and accuracy before submission
* Resolve discrepancies and follow up on missing information
* Keep CRM records current and complete, including significant provider communications and project updates

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**

* 2+ years of experience in vendor coordination, contractor coordination, dispatch, scheduling, project coordination, field operations, or a similar role
* Strong phone presence, comfortable spending much of the day on calls and email with contractors, vendors, or small business owners
* Persistent follow-up skills, especially with people who are busy and slow to respond
* Strong attention to detail and a track record of accuracy in data entry, documentation review, or administrative operations
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and open items without dropping details
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable learning new technology platforms and working in a remote environment
* Willingness to travel occasionally for company events or field visits

**Preferred**

* Experience in construction, home services, remodeling, or accessibility modifications
* Experience with claims processing, billing, or order management
* Experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM

**How We Invest In You**
------------------------

* Generous company-funding of our health, vision, and dental plans
* HSA plans

ccbc9a511d3f571ca2d2.title: Project Coordinator/Assistant

0ef0ac066912213e4569.title: Agroforestry Contracts Coordinator
0ef0ac066912213e4569.description:
### **What We Can Achieve Together:**

  

The North America Agroforestry Contracts Coordinator will be responsible for a variety of activities in support of the program’s approved tactics and in support of the strategic priorities of the team. They will complete activities with multiple variables, setting realistic deadlines and managing the timeline. They will provide guidance in satisfying requirements based on extensive knowledge of policies and procedures. The Coordinator will be responsible for ensuring timely and accurate payments including but not limited to vendors, project partners and farmers who have met contractual obligations to implement agroforestry practices. The Coordinator will provide technical leadership and support to plan, direct, and implement effective processes for managing the contracts and payments, and lead communication efforts related to their execution. They will be responsible for scheduling and coordinating virtual and in-person meetings with vendors, project partners and/or producers as necessary to provide updates on process requirements. Duties may include assisting in the development of reports by collecting, assembling, and analyzing various types of programmatic data (both internal audiences and external project partners and funders). The Coordinator will handle inquiries about program activities and assist in the development of program materials and correspondence. They will work cooperatively with Conservancy staff, providing information necessary to make decisions and solve problems. The Coordinator may communicate on behalf of their supervisor with internal and external sources including staff, donors, vendors, and businesses in order to coordinate arrangements, convey information, and ensure successful execution of the program. The Coordinator will take on additional duties to enhance the work of the team, including, but not limited to, enhancing the systems and tools used by the team. They will keep up-to-date on market trends and best practices and adapt processes in order to improve services. The position will include limited travel, and may include limited work in the evenings and weekends as needed.

**Responsibilities & Scope**

* Work within scope of program’s strategic goals.
* Act independently on assigned tasks and exercise independent judgment based on analysis and experience, referring difficult questions and unusual problems to supervisor.
* Coordinate projects with several variables, working within a defined timeline and budget.
* Demonstrate sensitivity in handling confidential information.
* Perform non-routine analysis, research and follow-through.
* Ensure compliance with Conservancy policies and procedures, and external (donor/legal/IRS) requirements.
* Financial responsibility includes purchasing, processing invoices, contracting with vendors, and assisting with budget preparation.
* May act as a resource to others to solve problems and act in supervisor’s stead when instructed.
* Provide input through project teams for the improvement of existing programs.
* Work environment involves only infrequent exposure to disagreeable elements and minor physical exertion and/or strain.
* Work is diversified and may not always fall under established practices and guidelines.
* May require occasional domestic travel for multi-day retreats, meetings, and conferences.
May work flexible hours, including off-hours calls, to coordinate with staff, partners and suppliers across the US.  

This is a full-time position, grant-funded through March 31, 2029 with the possibility of extension based on continued grant funding. Working location is remote from a home office within the continental United States or nearby TNC office if space is available.

  

### **We’re Looking for You:**

  

The North America Agriculture Program (“NA Ag”) is a highly matrixed team that works closely with TNC divisions; state business units (BUs); and whole system and global teams to scale up the adoption of regenerative agriculture practices and programs across the U.S. We work with public agencies, companies, NGOs and others to unlock financial and technical assistance, mitigate risk, support producer-led networks, bolster innovation and technology, and advocate for best policies that enable agriculture practices that improve environmental and social outcomes. The North America Agroforestry Program is an initiative within NA Ag that currently focuses on implementation of a large USDA Advancing Markets for Producers grant that aims to deliver incentive payments to producers for planting trees, provide technical assistance for producers, and develop markets for agroforestry products. We’re looking for a mission-driven, project management professional that understands how operations contribute to team and organizational success to support these efforts. The ideal candidate should have a strong project management skillset with experience leading operations functions for a diverse, multi-disciplinary team. They will possess exceptional communication and collaboration skills and experience designing, organizing, and directing complex projects. If you have a passion for conserving and protecting the natural world, addressing climate change and enhancing the sustainability of our food system, and believe in TNC’s mission and values, please apply for this position and learn more about the Conservancy.

  

### **What You’ll Bring:**

Minimum Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree and 2 years related experience or equivalent combination.
* Experience coordinating administrative processes.
* Experience generating reports and interpreting data.
* Experience in business writing, editing, and proofreading.
* Experience organizing time and managing diverse activities to meet deadlines.
* Experience working across teams and communicating with a wide range of people.
Experience managing contracting and payment processes.  

  

Desired Qualifications:

* Experience engaging with and serving farmers
* Demonstrated experience using diplomacy and tact to build strong relationships
Knowledge of current trends in regenerative agriculture and/or agroforestry  

  

### **Salary Information:**

  

The starting pay range for a candidate selected for this position is generally within the range of $50,000 - $70,000. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. Where a successful candidate’s actual pay will fall within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including, for example, the candidate's location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. Please note countries outside the USA would have a different pay range in the local currency based on the local labor market, and not tied to USA pay or ranges. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment.

### **Who We Are** **:**

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor .

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

### **What We Bring:**

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!
  
  
TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits.
  
  
We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports of the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

**Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.**

**The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.
  
  
Do you have military experience? Visit our U.S. Military Skills Translator to match your military experience with our current job openings!
  
  
TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to applyhelp@tnc.org with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

**SUMMARY**

The Senior Post-Pay Operations Coordinator facilitates changes and coordinates ongoing work related to the submission of change requests, review of business requirements, and participation in the Coordination of Benefits and Recovery (COB&R) Change Control Board (CCB). Monitors operational impacts of new initiatives such as the Medicare Secondary Payer Recovery Portal (MSPRP). Responsible for working with the Medicare Secondary Payer Integration Contractor (MSPIC) and Medicare Secondary Payer Systems Contractor (MSPSC) to ensure that impacts to the operation are managed appropriately. Identifies opportunities to better utilize existing systems and integrate system changes into the existing procedures.

  

**Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc.** serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Business Services, Health, Infrastructure and Engineering, Mission Optimization, Technology and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical - Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays.

  

**JOB SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES**

* Must be able to obtain and maintain required government clearance to access facilities, systems.
* Excellent computer skills with proficiency using Microsoft Office ( *i.e.,* Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, etc.).
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills.
* Ability to deliver a customer service approach.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
* Excellent organization skills with ability to handle multiple projects and priorities
* Well organized, detail-oriented and self-motivated
Ability to effectively work both independently and in a team environment  

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  

* Acts as the single point of contact (SPOC) for coordination with the MSPIC and MSPSC, focusing on recovery business processes, analysis, process improvements, and system impact assessments. Supports remaining BPOC systems.
* Develops communication plans, coaches leaders through change, and maintains tracking systems to ensure changes are fully vetted, documented, and implemented.

* Ensures change management processes integrate with release, configuration, asset, incident, problem, training, SOP development, QA, and reporting functions.
* Develops targeted change management plans, including communication, outreach, training, SOP, QA, implementation, and resistance management.
* Identifies resistance and performance gaps, collaborating with IT and QA to implement corrective actions.
* Works collaboratively with project teams, integrating change management into project plans. Contributes to detailed work plan schedules and milestones.
* Facilitates internal change review meetings and participates in COB&R CCB meetings. Produces change management deliverables aligned with program methodologies.

Maintains confidentiality, data integrity, and security. Ensures adherence to qualitative and quantitative standards required by contractual and business needs.

Associate's degree (A. A.) or equivalent from two-year College or technical school; or 18 months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Required to speak and hear. Occasionally required to stand, walk and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. bc1c26d2ed6585e295a8.title: Agency Acquisitions Project Manager
bc1c26d2ed6585e295a8.description:
**About Brightway**

Established in 2008, Brightway is proud to be one of the fastest-growing insurance agency systems in the United States. With over 350 franchises spanning 35+ states and an impressive $1.3 billion in annual premiums, we rank among the nation’s largest privately owned property and casualty insurance distribution companies. We support our agency owners with comprehensive back-office services, marketing resources, and continuous learning and development.

We are embarking on the next stage of our customer-centric growth, driven by innovation from our talented associates and the application of cutting-edge technologies. This growth has opened doors for creative thinkers who thrive in a diverse and collaborative culture. As a Brightway team member, you'll engage in exciting projects that are reshaping the industry, working alongside a dedicated team committed to delivering exceptional customer service and safeguarding our clients' most valuable assets.

-

**Scope**

Brightway is seeking an Agency Acquisitions Project Manager to own end-to-end project management for agency and book acquisitions from Letter of Intent (LOI) through close. As the operational backbone of Brightway’s M&A program, this role ensures every acquisition—whether a franchise conversion or a jointly structured book purchase—moves efficiently from signed LOI to a fully integrated, closed deal.

This role sits at the intersection of operations, carrier relations, and cross-functional coordination. The ideal candidate is a highly organized, detail-oriented project manager who can manage multiple concurrent deals, hold internal and external partners accountable to deadlines, and keep closings on track. This position offers regular visibility to Brightway’s leadership team and the opportunity to help scale a critical growth function.

The primary objective of this role is to accelerate deal closings and reduce the time from LOI to close by managing the full lifecycle of each acquisition with rigor, urgency, and clear communication.

**Role Overview**

The Agency Acquisitions Project Manager leads each acquisition through the post-LOI process. Brightway’s M&A program includes two primary deal types:

* Franchise Conversions — Brightway acquires an independent agent’s book of business, and the agent converts their existing agency into a Brightway franchise.
* Book Acquisitions — Brightway jointly purchases a book of business with an existing Brightway franchisee.

Across both deal types, this role coordinates due diligence, gathers policy-level and carrier information, ensures data is organized and delivered to the QC team for entry into the agency management system, and drives all workstreams through closing.

**Job Responsibilities**

1. Deal Project Management

* Own the project plan, milestone timeline, and deal calendar for each active acquisition from LOI through close.
* Maintain a master deal tracker with status, open items, owners, dependencies, and target close dates.
* Manage process checklists and keep all workstreams moving in parallel.
* Proactively identify risks, remove roadblocks, and escalate complex issues to the right stakeholders with a clear path to resolution.
* Act as the primary post-LOI point of contact for internal stakeholders, external partners, and acquisition participants.

2. Due Diligence Coordination

* Collect, organize, and track all due diligence materials required to evaluate, process, and close each deal.
* Follow up with agents, carriers, and internal teams to ensure materials are complete and received on time.
* Maintain organized, audit-ready documentation for each acquisition.

3. Carrier Coordination & Policy Data

* Partner with Brightway’s carrier team and, when needed, carriers directly to obtain policy lists and book-level information for each acquired book of business.
* Track carrier appointment transfers and code migrations required to bring new agents into Brightway’s systems.
* Learn and document carrier-specific processes for book transfers to ensure consistency and replicability across deals.

4. QC & System Integration

* Compile and present policy information to the QC team in the format required for entry into the agency management system.
* Monitor data completeness and accuracy; flag discrepancies and work with relevant parties to resolve.
* Ensure a seamless handoff to the QC and onboarding teams so each deal closes cleanly and transitions smoothly.

5. Agent Communication & Onboarding Support

* Serve as a key point of contact for incoming agents during the acquisition process, setting clear expectations and providing timely updates.
* Conduct orientation calls with new agents as needed to explain the appointment and migration process.
* Manage inbound requests from internal and external partners and follow up on action items appropriately.

**Skills, Licenses, Certifications**

* Strong project management skills, including the ability to build and manage timelines, own deliverables, and drive work to completion across multiple concurrent deals.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in a high-stakes environment.
* Strong communicator able to convey information clearly and concisely to agents, carriers, and senior leadership.
* Proactive, service-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through.
* Ability to understand and navigate insurance carrier processes and operations.
* Strong independent judgment and sound decision-making under time pressure.
* Excellent time management skills, with the ability to prioritize across a portfolio of active deals and manage competing demands.
* Team player who can both contribute independently and rely on cross-functional colleagues to move deals forward.
* Demonstrates Brightway values of Smart, Accountable, and Trustworthy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint); experience with CRM, workflow, or project management tools is a plus.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred; high school diploma or equivalent required.
* 3–5 years of experience in project management, operations, or a related field.
* Experience in insurance—whether with an agency, carrier, or insurance operations team—strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with insurance carrier appointment processes and/or policy data systems a significant plus.
* Experience in a transaction, M&A, or deal-driven environment is a plus, but not required.
* Property & Casualty insurance license is a plus, or willingness to obtain one.

-

***Equal Employment Opportunity:***  
*Brightway Insurance is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that values and respects the contributions of all individuals. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

*We believe that a diverse workforce is essential to our success and fosters innovation, creativity, and collaboration. Our goal is to provide a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment, where everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and grow.*

0f21ed833fae3d3b3195.title: Patient Care Coordinator
0f21ed833fae3d3b3195.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and compassionate Patient Care Coordinator to join our healthcare team. In this vital role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for patients, ensuring a seamless experience from appointment scheduling to follow-up care. Your energetic approach and excellent communication skills will help foster positive patient relationships, support clinical staff, and uphold the highest standards of patient confidentiality and care. This position offers an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful difference in patients’ lives while working in a fast-paced, supportive environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage patient appointments efficiently using electronic health records (EHR) and patient management software, ensuring accurate scheduling and timely follow-up.
* Serve as the first point of contact for patients via phone, email, and in-person interactions, providing courteous and professional customer service.
* Assist with medical administrative tasks such as verifying insurance coverage, processing billing information, and maintaining detailed patient records in compliance with health regulation policies.
* Communicate effectively with healthcare providers, patients, and insurance companies to coordinate care plans and resolve scheduling or billing issues.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of all patient information in accordance with HIPAA regulations and other privacy standards.
* Support clinical staff by preparing medical documentation, managing electronic health records (EHR/EHR), and handling administrative support tasks.
* Stay informed about health regulation policies to ensure clinic compliance and assist in implementing updates as needed.

**Experience**

* Prior experience working in a medical office or healthcare setting is highly preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel, and Outlook for documentation and communication purposes.
* Familiarity with medical terminology, health insurance processes, and health regulation policies enhances effectiveness in this role.
* Experience managing electronic health records (EHR/EHR) systems or patient management software is essential for smooth operations.
* Strong customer service skills with the ability to communicate clearly over the phone and in person while maintaining professionalism.
* Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive information discreetly while maintaining patient confidentiality.
* Excellent typing skills combined with attention to detail will support accurate record keeping and efficient workflow.

Join us as a Patient Care Coordinator where your enthusiasm, organizational skills, and dedication will directly impact patient satisfaction and overall clinic success!

Pay: $23.00 - $28.00 per hour

* Employee assistance program
* Employee stock purchase plan
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance

Position Overview

**Position Title**

Coordinator of Visit Experience

  

**Department**

522000 - Admissions

  

**Position Type**

Regular

Full-Time, 12 months

  

**Grant/Gift Funded (all or a portion)?**

No

  

**If Temporary or Grant Funded, Start Date and End Date**

Position Description/Posting Details

S1456P

  

**Position Summary**

The Coordinator of Visit Experience serves as the operational lead for campus visit programs, admissions events, and student visitor experience initiatives. Providing direct support to the Director of Visit Experience, this position oversees the daily execution of visit operations, develops student leaders, coordinates large-scale events, and partners with departments across the university to create welcoming, organized, inclusive and engaging experiences for prospective students and their families.

The role also entails building trainings for all students on the topics of professionalism, public speaking skills, and polished behaviors for the workforce and visitor facing environment. The Coordinator of Visit Experience must have the ability to interact in a positive and professional manner with students, faculty, administrators, staff and the public. It is critical that the coordinator possesses and utilizes excellent customer service as it relates to hosting campus guests, the ability to support and plan large-scale events, and has an eye for detail.

  

**Essential Duties**

Visitor Experience Operations

* Coordinate and support the prospective student visit experience, including daily campus tours, group visits, special events, and other recruitment activities.
* Plan and execute school and community group visits from start to finish, including scheduling, reserving campus spaces, coordinating student tour guides, and communications.
* Ensure daily visitor logistics are in place, including reserved parking signage, parking passes, visitor communications, and other hospitality-related details.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

* Work collaboratively with other divisional and University-wide departments to enhance the student experience, especially related to on campus recruitment activities.

La Salle University is dedicated to fostering a welcoming and respectful environment where all individuals can thrive. 2e98955156e307db9e11.title: District Support Pharmacist Part Time
2e98955156e307db9e11.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Job Purpose and Summary:**

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our District Support Pharmacists (DSPs) play a critical role in cultivating a culture of excellence within each pharmacy worked by acting as a role model for all, demonstrating genuine care, and setting the bar for the pharmacy team.

As a DSP, you have a critical role at the forefront of delivering our purpose, modeling our values, and demonstrating genuine, authentic care for our patients. You will work within the district to cover pharmacist scheduling gaps, under the direction of the Pharmacy Manager (PM) and Rx District Leader (DL) to support our pharmacy teams. While working in stores throughout the district, you are accountable for supporting the management, oversight, and operation of the pharmacy and pharmacy team.

The DSP’s responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Living our purpose by helping to manage and improve patient health through safe and appropriate dispensing, counseling, and immunizing practices
* Traveling the district to fill pharmacist shifts as scheduled by the District Performance Coordinator (DPC); overseeing the pharmacy and serving as the Pharmacy Manager’s proxy during bench shifts without overlap
* Supporting safe and accurate prescription fulfillment by following—and directing the pharmacy team to follow—pharmacy workflow procedures and utilizing the safety guardrails at every workstation
* Assumes Pharmacy Manager’s day-to-day duties when serving as the only or the primary pharmacist-on-duty
* Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care and coaching the pharmacy team to do the same: demonstrating compassionate care, collaborating with the patient’s total healthcare team, and proactively resolving insurance and/or medication issues
* Proactively offering and delivering immunizations to keep patients healthy; engaging and supporting Pharmacy Technicians to learn to immunize
* Supporting the effective management of pharmacy inventory in all pharmacies worked by following—and guiding the pharmacy team to follow—all inventory best practices, with a special focus on protecting cold chain products for our patients and our business
* Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic
* Maintaining relevant clinical and technical skills for the job as the industry evolves (including but not limited to company-required trainings and CMEs); actively seeking opportunities to expand knowledge to better support patients
* Supporting access to care and helping to improve patient outcomes through pharmacist delivered clinical care such as testing and prescribing services (e.g., COVID/Flu, Hormonal Contraception, etc.) where permissible; empowers the pharmacy team to provide holistic care at every step in the patient care journey

Wells Fargo is seeking a Branch Operations Coordinator for our National Branch Network as part of the Consumer Banking and Lending division. Learn more about the career areas and business divisions at wellsfargojobs.com.

* Motivate a diverse team to achieve full potential and meet established business objectives

* 1+ year of customer service and issue resolution support experience,or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Ability to provide strong customer service while listening, eliciting information and comprehending customer issues
* Ability to educate and connect customers to technology and share the value of mobile banking options
* Ability to interact with integrity and professionalism with customers and employees
* Ability to identify potential fraud/risky accounts and take appropriate action to prevent loss
* Cash handling experience
* Well-organized, independent and able to prioritize in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to exercise judgment, raise questions to management, and adhere to policy guidelines

* Motivate others to achieve full potential and meet established business objectives

Motus is the definitive leader in mobile workforce solutions. Its platform simplifies the reimbursement and management of vehicle, device, and location costs through personalized calculations. At Motus, we're dedicated to making WorkLife better for everyone, anywhere. Our team is the heart of our culture, and we live by our WorkLife Pillars every day – WorkHappy, WorkHealthy, WorkSmart, WorkAnywhere, and WorkTogether.

**Position Description:**

Motus is looking for a Customer Service professional to join the team as a Vehicle Support Specialist. You will learn the foundation of our business model by serving as the front-line to our customer base and work towards becoming a guide on Motus' suite of products to provide support to our administrators and end-users. You will strengthen customer relationships and ensure positive engagement with Motus products by supporting inquiries via phone, email, and web chat.

This role will kickstart your career in a high-growth Software-as-a-Service organization, work with a tight-knit team, and help make work-life better for customers across every industry and state. * Exemplary verbal and written communication skills
* Experience with Zendesk a plus
* Commitment to service excellence
* Ability to articulate complex and technical concepts
* A positive, adaptable and enthusiastic team member
* Strong teammate and commitment to get the job done, no matter how big or small
* Strong ability to prioritize and meet a dedicated timeline
* Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
* History of excelling in collaborative team environments
* Commitment to success—for yourself and your team
* Analytical mind-set who loves solving problems
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

* Make outbound follow-up calls to communicate utilizing email and product demonstrations.
* Performs other projects or miscellaneous duties as requested or assigned.

* High School Diploma or GED. Post-secondary-education strongly preferred.

Experience:

* 1 - 2 years in sales and /or customer account service/support or sales prospecting/sales cycle management.

7611b0c7c1002b62c377.title: Partnership Manager, Home Care 100
7611b0c7c1002b62c377.description:
Partnership Manager, Home Care 100

Location: Remote

Position Type: Full-time/Non-Exempt

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Lincoln Healthcare Leadership is seeking a **Partnership Manager** to strengthen partner engagement, drive long-term relationship success, and execute best-in-class partner experiences throughout the Home Care 100 conference portfolio.

Companies sponsor Lincoln Healthcare Leadership conferences because they see our events as beneficial to their market positioning and business development efforts. We refer to these sponsors as conference "partners."

The Partnership Manager serves as a primary steward of Home Care 100’s partner relationships, helping ensure partners receive exceptional value throughout their engagement lifecycle. This role combines strategic relationship management, partner retention, benefits fulfillment, and conference execution support.

Beyond coordinating contracted benefits, this role develops a deep understanding of partner organizations, business priorities, growth strategies, and evolving market needs. Through proactive outreach and ongoing relationship management, the Partnership Manager helps identify opportunities, mitigate risks, and strengthen long-term partner engagement and retention.

This role operates as an extension of the Sales team focusing on relationship health and partner retention. This is a highly collaborative role requiring strong attention to detail, communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Partner Stewardship & Retention**

You will serve as a relationship manager for Lincoln's sponsoring partners, helping build long-term engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

Responsibilities include:

* Conduct regular partner check-ins, with increased frequency and deeper engagement for Home Care 100’s highest-level partners

* Develop a strong understanding of partner business objectives, strategic priorities, growth initiatives, and market positioning

* Maintain ongoing visibility into partner organizational changes, including leadership transitions, mergers, acquisitions, and other developments that may impact engagement

* Identify and communicate potential retention risks, opportunities, and emerging partner needs to internal stakeholders

* Serve as a trusted point of contact for partners throughout the year, including through structured, recurring business reviews for key accounts, collaborating with Sales

* Support long-term relationship growth by identifying opportunities for deeper partner engagement and enhanced value delivery

* Document key relationship insights, conversations, and organizational updates to support continuity and strategic account management

**Partner Benefits Fulfillment & Deliverable Execution**

You will ensure all contracted partner benefits are delivered accurately, consistently, and at a high level of quality.

* Deliver fulfillment of all partner benefits in conjunction with sponsor sales, operations, and marketing teams.

* Track sponsorship deliverables and results

* Coordinate with internal departments to ensure clear communication and execution of deliverables.

* Monitor partner satisfaction and proactively address concerns related to benefit fulfillment

* Maintain accurate records of partner commitments, deliverables, communications, and engagement history

* Ensure fulfillment activities align with each partner's unique business objectives and goals whenever possible

**Conference Preparation & Execution Support**

You will serve as a key coordinator in the delivery of partner benefits for Home Care 100 conferences.

* Ensure clear and timely communication and a positive conference experience.

* Maintain a high-quality standard across all procedures and communications.

* Manage partner inquiries (email and phone) with prompt and accurate support and follow-up.

* Support partner relationship management before, during, and after conferences

* Help identify meaningful connections and engagement opportunities that align with partner goals

* Provide on-site support to ensure a seamless and high-touch partner experience

* Gather feedback from partners to continuously improve conference value and experience

*This job description outlines the primary responsibilities of the role but is not intended to be an exhaustive list. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support team and organizational priorities.*

**REPORTING & COLLABORATION**

This role reports to Managing Director, Home Care 100 with a dotted line to SVP, Sales.

This role works closely with internal teams including Sales, Operations, and Marketing to ensure successful partner experiences and execution of conference deliverables.

The Partnership Manager serves as an important bridge between partners and internal teams, helping ensure partner needs, risks, opportunities, and priorities are communicated effectively throughout the organization.

**WHO YOU ARE**

We're looking for someone who brings strong organizational skills, communication abilities, and a proactive mindset.

* **Deadline-driven and detail-oriented:** Able to manage multiple partners and ensure timely, accurate delivery of materials and benefits.

* **Strong interpersonal skills:** Comfortable communicating with executives at all levels, including C-suite, and resolving issues diplomatically.

* **Assertive:** Able to proactively follow up and obtain necessary information to meet deadlines.

* **Customer service-focused:** Dedicated to guiding partners through the benefits delivery process and supporting their needs.

* **Strong writing skills:** Communicates clearly and concisely regarding expectations and deadlines.

* **Administrative strength:** Highly organized with the ability to manage high volumes of communication, scheduling, multiple processes, and documentation across teams.

* **Quality-driven:** Committed to producing high-quality work that supports Lincoln's reputation.

* **Enthusiastic, driven, and independent:** Capable of managing complex workflows with minimal oversight.

* **Relationship builder:** Able to establish credibility and long-term trust with senior executives and key stakeholders.

* **Business-curious:** Interested in understanding partner organizations, industry trends, and strategic priorities.

* **Proactive and consultative:** Anticipates needs, identifies issues early, and takes initiative to solve problems.

* **Commercially minded:** Understands the importance of partner satisfaction, retention, and long-term relationship growth.

* **Strategic communicator:** Able to balance relationship management, service excellence, and business objectives.

**Additional Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive) or equivalent productivity software.

* Working knowledge of customer relationship management (CRM) and event management platforms, such as HubSpot and Cvent, preferred.

* Ability to travel.

*We understand that not every candidate will meet every qualification listed. If you bring relevant, transferable skills and a willingness to learn, we’d love to hear from you.*

**LOCATION & TRAVEL**

This position may be fully remote or hybrid based out of our Southport, CT office.

Travel required for attendance at two conferences per year (approximately four days at each):

* Home Care 100 Winter: January 31-February 3, 2027, Ritz-Carlton Orlando Grande Lakes, FL
* Home Care 100 Summer: June 13-16, 2027, The Grand America Hotel, Salt Lake City, UT

Additional travel is possible for other Lincoln Healthcare Leadership events (up to two additional conferences, approximately 3-4 days each) and to partner user conferences (approximately 3 times a year for 2-3 days each).

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

We offer a competitive and thoughtful total rewards package, including:

* Base salary: $85,000-$100,000 \*Actual salaries may vary within or outside the stated range based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievements, business needs, and geographic location. Candidates are encouraged to include their salary expectations with their application.

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

* 401(k) with company match

* Generous PTO, sick leave and paid parental leave policies

* Flexible work arrangements and remote work options where applicable

* Sabbatical eligibility

* Profit sharing after 1 year of employment

**WHY JOIN LINCOLN HEALTHCARE LEADERSHIP?**

At Lincoln Healthcare Leadership, you’ll be part of a team with a powerful **purpose**: *elevating healthcare by inspiring leaders.* Our **mission** is to drive excellence in healthcare leadership, strategy, and innovation through exceptional insights and exceptional communities—improving the U.S. healthcare system toward higher quality, lower cost, and more coordinated care.

**Our values guide how we show up every day:**

* **Integrity** – We do the right thing for our clients, our communities, and each other.
* **Leadership** – We define what’s next and lead others towards that vision.
* **Culture** – We each contribute to creating an environment where people thrive.
* **Service** – We lead with warmth, care and professionalism.
* **Quality** – We hold a high bar in everything we do.
* **Teamwork** – We are one Lincoln team, supporting each other to deliver results.
* **Boldness** – We challenge the status quo in all aspects of our business pursuits.

We are committed to being an **employer of choice**, prioritizing flexibility, well-being, and professional growth.

d7fea784d8aa48b04b8d.description:
**Why Work For Us**
===================

Alexander Shunnarah Trial Attorneys is a rapidly growing personal injury law firm based in Alabama with offices across the nation. We handle complex cases and provide each attorney and staff with the support they need enabling us to best serve our clients. Our attorneys and staff pride themselves on their skill set, experience, compassion, and commitment. We are dedicated to giving our clients the utmost attention and care while fighting for them to get what they deserve.

At Alexander Shunnarah Trial Attorneys, we take a real approach. We are innovative, always finding ways to be better, and have a go-getter mentality across the board. Each team member plays a critical role in our mission. We know our people are what makes us great. If you're looking for a career where you can help make a difference in the lives of others alongside a supportive team, we encourage you to apply!

**What We Value**
=================

* Client Commitment
* Integrity
* A Will to Win
* Teamwork
* Personal Accountability
* Passion

**What You'll Do:**
===================

We're looking for an organized, compassionate, bilingual Medical Appointment Coordinator to own one critical step in our clients' journey: getting them scheduled for, and to, their telemedicine visit and MRI. You'll sit between our Client Representative and Case Manager teams, making sure each client gets connected to these appointments quickly and shows up prepared. Once those appointments are complete, you hand the client off and move on to the next.

This is a scheduling and follow-through role. You will not provide medical advice or be involved in any other treatment.

This is a 100% remote contractor position. Personal computer equipment is required and will not be provided. This position could become full time with benefits in the future.

### **Specifically, You Will:**

* Contact assigned clients by phone, text, and email, in English and Spanish, to schedule telemedicine visits and MRI appointments
* Coordinate with providers and imaging facilities to find openings that work for the client
* Send appointment reminders and check in with clients on the day of their appointments
* Follow up on missed or canceled appointments and reschedule promptly
* Confirm appointments were completed and document outcomes in our case management system (FileVine)
* Communicate status updates and hand-offs to the Client Representative and Case Management teams
* Keep clear, accurate, timely notes on every client interaction
* Handle sensitive conversations with patience and empathy, since many clients are recovering from injuries and under stress

**What You Need:**
==================

* Fluent or native proficiency in both English and Spanish (spoken and written) *required*
* 1+ years of experience in the medical field *required*. This could be scheduling, patient access, call center, or customer service work
* Strong phone presence: warm, patient, and professional with anxious or frustrated callers
* Excellent organization and follow-up; you close loops and don't let appointments fall through the cracks
* Comfort learning new software and managing a high volume of scheduling tasks
* Ability to protect confidential client and health information
* High school diploma or equivalent

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience scheduling imaging or radiology appointments
* Familiarity with medical terminology or telehealth platforms
* Experience in a law firm, personal injury, or insurance setting
* Prior EHR or case management system experience

**What You Get:**
=================

* **A Great Role:** Remote, contract position with opportunities to grow and contribute to impactful cases.
* **A Supportive Environment:** Join a team that values collaboration, innovation, and your professional development.

**Ready to advance your career and make a real difference?** Apply now and become a vital part of our dedicated team!

Alexander Shunnarah Trial Attorneys is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Alexander Shunnarah Trial Attorneys is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please email **careers@asilpc.com**.

**Patient Referral Coordinator — NuNavigator Program**  
Remote | Full-Time | NuNavigator Patient Services

  

**Who We Are**

NuvemRx helps community health providers deliver on their mission by simplifying the complexity of pharmacy operations, with a suite of scalable solutions that integrate software, intelligence, and expert support to illuminate savings, expand access, and elevate patient care.

**What We Are Looking For**

At NuvemRx, we hold a high bar because our work directly impacts patient care. We look for people who embody our core values:

* **Mission Always:** Every choice is a chance to serve our customers and improve healthcare
* **Be a Pioneer:** Take initiative, solve problems, and build what does not yet exist
* **Do the Right Thing the Right Way:** Lead with integrity, compliance, and thoughtful execution
* **Stronger Together:** Own your role, collaborate deeply, and elevate the team

  

We are also a fast-growing company, which means you bring strong ownership, comfort with ambiguity, resilience, and a bias toward action.

**About the Role**

The Patient Referral Coordinator keeps NuNavigator patients connected to the specialty care they need. Working alongside our FQHC partner, you manage the full referral-to-appointment journey: scheduling specialist visits, reminding patients so they show up prepared, managing no-shows and waitlists, and setting up follow-up care. You also help patients understand how the onsite pharmacy supports their care and keep information flowing smoothly between the health center and specialty offices.

This is a fully remote role, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States. We have a strong preference for candidates located in the **Sharon Hill, PA (Greater Philadelphia) or Dallas, TX area**, though the right person will be considered regardless of location.

  

**What You'll Do**

**Scheduling & Referral Coordination**

* Schedule specialist appointments for referred patients and confirm details with the patient and specialty office.
* Deliver appointment reminders via phone, text, and other channels to reduce missed visits.
* Manage no-shows and cancellations — follow up with patients, reschedule promptly, and keep the process moving.
* Maintain and work waitlists, filling earlier openings quickly as they become available.
* Schedule follow-up appointments and confirm patients complete their recommended care.

**Patient Education & Care Coordination**

* Educate patients on the benefits of using the FQHC's onsite pharmacy, including care coordination, convenience, and improved access to medications.
* Coordinate with specialty care offices to ensure referral documentation, records, and results are shared accurately and on time.
* Keep referral and scheduling records current and accurate in the patient management system.
* Handle all patient information in accordance with HIPAA and NuvemRx compliance policies.

**What You Bring**

**Core Capabilities**

* 2+ years in a healthcare, medical office, pharmacy, or patient services setting; scheduling, referral coordination, or intake experience preferred.
* Strong phone and written communication skills with a patient, service-oriented manner.
* Comfort with EHR, scheduling, or referral management software and general computer proficiency.
* Ability to manage a high volume of appointments and referrals while keeping records accurate and organized.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in an FQHC, community health, or care coordination environment.
* Familiarity with specialty care referral workflows.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish.

**Who Thrives in This Role**

* You are meticulous about follow-through — nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.
* You bring genuine empathy and professionalism with patients who may be navigating a stressful or difficult health situation.
* You are comfortable juggling competing priorities, switching between systems, and coordinating across multiple offices.
* You collaborate naturally with health center teams, specialty offices, and pharmacy staff to keep patients moving through their care.
* You are adaptable and curious, especially as technology continues to shape how care coordination work gets done.

**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation based on experience
* Remote-first work environment
* Generous PTO
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Life and disability coverage
* Employee Assistance Program
* A collaborative, mission-driven team
* WFH stipend

**Compensation**

*The expected base salary for this role is $52,000 – $72,000. This range may vary based on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.*

  

*NuvemRx complies with applicable pay transparency laws. The compensation range listed reflects the expected base salary at the time of posting, and actual compensation may vary.*

  

*NuvemRx is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.*

  

*NuvemRx is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruiting@nuvemrx.com.*

5cc71ab20fe14b7fc88b.description:
It’s an exciting time to join the WellSense Health Plan, a growing regional health insurance company with a 25-year history of providing health insurance that works for our members, no matter their circumstances.

  

**Job Summary:**

The Care Coordinator, BH is a member of the Behavioral Health Care Management (BH CM) team whose role is to perform telephonic outreach and screenings of identified members and to provide coordination of BH and community resources. The Care Coordinator, BH supports members and providers across service areas, identifies facilities and programs, and advocates and coordinates care for the members to ensure access to BH services and to community resources that address social determinants of health. The Care Coordinator, BH triages for and collaborates with clinical staff to ensure members receive appropriate care management.

The Care Coordinator, BH collaborates with their clinical team members, the Customer Care department and other internal departments to support member needs.

  

Our Investment in You:

* Full-time remote work

* Competitive salaries

* Excellent benefits

  

**Key Functions/Responsibilities:**

* Uses motivational interviewing skills to engage members into care management via telephonic outreach.

* Provides information to members with the goal of increasing member knowledge and participation in their own healthcare management including but not limited to information on how to obtain resources; basic health information; information packets containing health information relative to the Member’s identified condition

* Maintains current knowledge of community resources for referral and linkage to meet Members’ needs

* Advocates for the Member and coordinates BH/SUD and community resources

* Answers and triages calls from the department’s toll-free line

* Monitors the team’s mailbox and relays information received to Care Managers and triages referrals received via email

* Triages cases to clinical staff

* Facilitates referrals, performs telephonic screenings, arranges wellness visits and provides appointment and preventative care reminders, as needed

* Coordinates and facilitates access to BH/SUD services, resolves issues related to social determinants of health and collaborates with providers, facilities, state agencies, BH CM team, and other departments

* Maintains accurate and timely documentation in the medical management information system (Jiva) in keeping with contractual requirements, internal policy and accreditation standards.

* Partners with department leadership and team members to organize staff assignments, prioritize and triage activities and calls.

* Provide administrative support to the BH CM team.

* Responsible for preparing department data/reports assigned by Management

* Identifies opportunities for improvement in administrative workflows and processes

* Performs other associated tasks as assigned by Manager/Supervisor

  

**Supervision Exercised:**

* N/A

  

**Supervision Received:**

* Weekly and on-going from Manager/Supervisor of Care Management, BH

  

**Qualifications:**

**Education Required:**

* Associate’s degree required in health care or a related area

* Bachelor’s degree in psychology, social work, or related area (preferred)

  

**Experience Required:**

* Experience in either a high-volume customer service call center, data entry office, or health care office administration department

  

**Preferred/Desirable:**

* Prior customer service/call center experience

* Prior work with Medicaid population preferred

* Bilingual

  

**Certification or Conditions of Employment:**

* Pre-employment background check

  

**Competencies, Skills, and Attributes:**

* Ability to engage members

* Strong oral and written communication skills

* Detail oriented

* Ability to work independently but also in a team setting

* Ability to effectively collaborate with health care providers and all members of the interdisciplinary team

* Demonstrated ability to successfully prioritize, plan, organize and manage multiple tasks in a face-paced environment

* No or very limited exposure to physical risk.

* No or very limited physical effort required
