Honey Birdette was created by women for women, to offer an experience unlike any other lingerie retailer. We are a luxury lifestyle brand offering high-end lingerie and premium bedroom accessories. Bold, innovative and a little naughtier than you would expect, Honey Birdette has quickly become the most talked about lingerie brands. We inspire, create curiosity, and empower women through their beauty and confidence.

**Who We Seek**

The online **Customer Service Manager** is a hands‑on leader charged with shaping, supporting, and energising a high‑performing team to deliver stellar customer experiences across every touchpoint. You’ll handle all aspects of managing team —creating and approving monthly rosters and timesheets—while providing regular one‑on‑one coaching, managing escalated tickets, and identifying skill gaps for training. Front‑of‑house, you’ll manage live chats, calls, social media, Click & Collect, VIP invoicing, and order issues, maintaining 24/7 customer support. Operationally, you’ll coordinate with warehouse teams, manually process orders, resolve shipping or fraud issues, and file courier claims. With a proactive, solution‑oriented mindset, you’ll champion a customer‑centric culture—anticipating needs, actively resolving problems, and ensuring commitments are met. You’ll also produce weekly reports for e‑commerce, stay compliant with all HB/PLBY policies, participate in ongoing training, effectively communicate across internal channels, and take on additional responsibilities as required—always keeping the customer perspective front and centre. This role embodies the essence of true customer obsession, where every decision, process, and interaction is driven by the goal of delighting and retaining customers

**What You’ll Do - Job Responsibilities**

* Create and publish monthly team rosters, ensuring full regional coverage.
* Approve team timesheets and monitor adherence to scheduled hours.
* Conduct regular one-on-one coaching sessions with actionable development plans.
* Handle escalated tickets and identify training opportunities for team growth.
* Deliver weekly region performance reports and ad hoc analysis for e‑commerce.
* Lead daily briefings to align on objectives, updates, and customer priorities.
* Champion the customer perspective in all decisions and service delivery.
* Proactively resolve customer issues and ensure follow‑through on commitments.
* Manage live chats, calls, social media, and email inquiries to maintain 24/7 support coverage.
* Coordinate Click & Collect, unfulfilled orders, VIP invoicing, and gift card issues.
* Oversee manual order processing, fraud checks, and system error corrections.
* File courier claims, manage replacements, and enforce compliance with policies.
* Liaise with warehouse and opening office, facilitating respectful and clear communication.
* Participate in ongoing training, stay informed via internal channels, and suggest improvements.
* Perform additional duties as assigned, consistently focusing on customer obsession.

**What You’ll Bring - Qualifications and Skills**

* Previous experience in a customer service and omni-channel management is required
* Proven ability to manage multiple channels of communication in a timely and responsive manner
* Proven experience in fast paced working environment with ability to achieve set KPI’s.
* Customer experience driven, communications expert with positive outcomes at front of mind.
* Bubbly attitude, people orientated, and open minded.
* Experience in working across multiple systems at one time.
* Ability to understand and utilise company policies & processes.
* Enjoys collaborating with broader teams to achieve high commercial outcomes.
* Ability to deescalate situations and turn a potential negative experience into a positive one.
* Calm under pressure with proven ability to work within deadlines.
* Ability to work autonomously & within a team environment.
* Available to work a flexible schedule to meet the needs of the business, which include closing shifts, weekends and holiday shifts.
* Must have unrestricted access to work in the U.S.
* Must be at least eighteen (18) years of age.

**Physical Requirements**

The work environment and physical demands described here are representative of those that an employee will encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Able to lift and carry up to 25 lbs., perform frequent standing, walking, repetitive finger, hand and wrist motions, as well as bending, stooping, reaching, squatting, kneeling, pushing, pulling, climbing ladders, and work with cleaning chemicals.
* Able to stand and walk for up to 8 hours per shift.
* Ability to use technology (mobile devices, computers).
* Ability to read instructions, reports, and information on computer/register screens and to key information into the computer daily.

The pay for this position at the commencement of employment is expected to be $32.69 USD hourly; however, the base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive wages.
* Generous retail sales incentive programs.
* Encouraging & empowering environment with career progression and training opportunities.
* Employee assistance program for mental health and counseling services.
* 401k, including a matching discount from the company.
* Generous product discount!

**Working Conditions**

Candidates understand that Honey Birdette is a subsidiary of PLBY Group. Our brands are focused on creative freedom, artistic expression, and sex positivity. As a result, you understand that the business concept is based partly on sex appeal, nudity, and/or sexual wellness products.

You may be exposed to individuals in sexy and/or sexually provocative clothing, either in person or in photographs or videos; lewd and/or obscene language; depictions of lewd, risqué, intimate, or explicit acts or behaviors; conversations and discussions about sex, sexuality, and the human anatomy; conversations and discussions where vulgar language may be used, and where sexual jokes and innuendo may be expressed in their presence.

Candidates acknowledge that they do not find the job duties or work environment as described above to be offensive, intimidating, hostile, or unwelcome. Candidates also understand that, if hired, nothing shall prevent you from notifying the company immediately if you are exposed to conduct of any type that you find offensive and/or that makes you feel uncomfortable while you are performing your job duties.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Honey Birdette is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We are committed to recruiting, hiring, training, and promoting qualified people of all backgrounds, and we make all employment decisions without regard to any protected status. The right talent for us innately embodies our values. Come as you are.

#### **About Us**

At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice.

More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. From admin work to clinical care, our suite of innovative solutions work together to reduce administrative burden—empowering solo and small group practitioners to thrive alongside their clients.

Award-winning and people-first, SimplePractice is shaping the future of health tech. Recognized by MedTech Breakthrough, the Digital Health Awards, and BuiltIn's Best Places to Work.

#### **The Role**

We're looking for a friendly, eager-to-learn Support Specialist to join our Customer Success team.

SimplePractice is built for our customers, and supporting their success is our top priority. We strive to provide unparalleled support and encourage our customers to always let us know how we can improve our products.

In this role, you'll use your passion for collaboration and technology to provide our customers with a world-class experience. You would act as the front line of communication with our customers, serving inbound phone calls as well as assisting customers via chat and email. This role will give you the opportunity to provide tangible value and support to our growing community.

This is a full-time hourly (non-exempt) position, with overtime available during peak seasons. There is some flexibility with working hours over time. We're looking for individuals that can also offer non-traditional business hours availability, including weekends and evening hours, to help us manage our response time goals throughout the entire week.

#### **Essential Functions**

The essential functions listed below represent the primary duties of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers by delivering exceptional support through inbound phone calls, chat, and email.
* Provide customer support across assigned communication channels (e.g., phone, chat, email, and other support channels) during scheduled work assignments, or as otherwise directed based on business needs. The timeframe is approximately 6.5 -7 hours during each standard phone shift, or as otherwise assigned based on business needs. Maintaining consistent phone availability during designated coverage periods is an essential function of this role.
* Resolve customer inquiries efficiently by troubleshooting issues, researching solutions, and providing accurate, timely information while adhering to company policies and security requirements.
* Transition seamlessly between phone, chat, email, and other support channels as operational needs require.
* Accurately document customer interactions and resolutions within company systems.
* Escalate technical or complex customer issues to the appropriate internal teams when necessary.
* Schedule customer screen-sharing sessions and conduct outbound phone calls as needed to support issue resolution.

* + Identify and report knowledge gaps and work to get them added to our knowledge systems

#### **Physical & Work Environment Requirements**

The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.

* Remain seated at a workstation for extended periods throughout the workday.
* Frequently use a computer, keyboard, mouse, and multiple software applications simultaneously.
* Wear a headset and communicate verbally with customers for prolonged periods while maintaining clear and professional communication.

312cbaf970d21202fc3b.title: Development Donor Relations Coordinator
312cbaf970d21202fc3b.description:
Natural Lands, a vibrant, regional, non-profit organization and leader in land conservation, natural resource stewardship, and public engagement, seeks a Development Donor Relations Coordinator to join our team at our headquarters on the Hildacy Preserve in Media, Pennsylvania.

  

Since the early 1950s, Natural Lands has saved open space, cared for nature, and connected people to the outdoors in eastern Pennsylvania and southern New Jersey. Today, the organization is one of the nation’s largest regional land conservancies and is widely respected for its record of success, technical expertise, respectful and creative approach to partnerships, fiscal strength, and integrity.

  

Over the course of its nearly 70-year history, Natural Lands has helped preserve more than 135,000 acres including a network of over 40 nature preserves and one public garden across two states and 13 counties. These properties total 23,000 acres and include many of the most spectacular and diverse properties in the region, which are enjoyed by more than 300,000 visitors annually.

  

*Natural Lands seeks* *to hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not only because it’s the right thing to do, but because it makes our organization stronger. We aim to build a workplace where employees feel empowered to be their full, authentic selves. We welcome you to explore a career at Natural Lands.*

  

**Job Summary**

The Donor Relations Coordinator supports Natural Lands’ donor events and relationship advancement efforts. As an integral member of a highly motivated and collaborative team, the Donor Relations Coordinator is a key liaison—executing and partnering on projects that engage multiple team members.

This position will provide exceptional internal and external customer service to help ensure success in meeting the Development Department’s priorities for raising philanthropic revenue and advancing donor relations.

  

**This is a part-time, approximately 20 hours per week position.**

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Fundraising** **Support**

* Supports the Senior Director of Donor Relations with day-to-day activities to elevate donor engagement, moves management, and relationship advancement.
* Assists with donor research, portfolio management and coordination of other donor cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship strategies.
* Curates and maintains a library of standing communications materials and fresh news and updates for department staff to share with donors.
* Manages the supply of donor appreciation gifts.
* Arranges meeting logistics to include internal communications, food and beverage, virtual accessibility, and room coordination for department colleagues’ donor and prospect meetings.
* Records donor and prospect actions in the department’s Raiser’s Edge database.

  

**Development****Events**

* At the direction of the Senior Director of Donor Relations, assists with preparation and day-of logistics for high-profile development events – including maintaining registration lists and producing nametags, timelines, invitation production, event materials, event-related correspondence, set-up and striking, and post-event related follow-up.
* Supports frontline fundraisers’ events and outings by providing packing lists, collecting needed items, drafting guest logistics, and producing nametags.
* Coordinates with event-related vendors for scheduling, contracts, invoices, and payments.
* Actively assists with the production of Stardust, Natural Lands’ annual fundraising event – including maintaining accurate guest RSVPs, coordinating vendors and invoices, partnering with our graphics department for production management, creating internal timelines, and offering excellent customer service for guest inquiries and ticket purchasing.
* Builds upon our existing event standards guide and acts as a department liaison for events outside the development department. Provides creative and logistical support and ensures organizational tone, quality, and excellence in customer service.

  

**Leadership****Groups****and****Committees**

* Assists with preparations (including vendor coordination, purchasing, registration, internal communications), day-of production, and follow-up associated with the biannual, half-day President’s Council meetings.
* Provides food and beverage and logistical support for in-person Board of Trustees and NextGen Council meetings.

**Other**

* Performs other related duties and responsibilities as required.

* Minimum three to five years of experience performing administrative tasks and engaging in project coordination, preferably in a fundraising, marketing, event management, or hospitality setting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and keen eye for format and aesthetics.
* Exceptional customer services skills and comfortable interacting with colleagues, donors, and organizational leadership.
* Ability to work productively in a team environment.
* Excellent organizational skills, penchant for thoroughness, and attention to detail.
* Affinity for learning about and assisting with fundraising and relationship advancement core to any Development Department's functioning.
* Proficiency in utilizing Microsoft 365 and computer databases; virtual meeting management (Teams and Zoom); ability to learn specific digital communication and database software and to analyze and utilize database information; experience with Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge or similar fund-raising software preferred; experience with the Adobe Creative Suite preferred.
* Interest in conservation, the outdoors, and Natural Lands’ mission along with a desire to forge relationships that support that mission.

  

**Physical Requirements/Working Conditions**

* This position is primarily an office-based position, requiring frequent sitting for long periods, with occasional periods of walking, standing, bending, and reaching.
* The position is hybrid with a minimum of two days a week in the office. However, during training more in-office time may be necessary. The position requires use of the computer and the telephone.
* Work is primarily indoors but will include work outdoors in varying weather conditions, infrequent hiking hills and walking uneven terrain in addition to reaching, lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling for placement and setup of event support items up to 20-35 pounds (tables, chairs, signs, displays, etc.).
* A reliable vehicle and valid driver’s license are required for travel throughout the region (eastern PA and southern NJ) for meetings, events, and project-related tasks.
* Position requires a flexible schedule with the ability to work evenings and weekends, particularly during busy seasons.

***Natural Lands is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.***

480999a5e65d38bf8c27.title: Branch Coordinator
480999a5e65d38bf8c27.description:
At Accendra Health, we understand that healthcare is complex, and we’re here to make it easier. We help deliver care beyond traditional settings, making essential products and services more accessible through every stage of life. As part of the care team, our teammates play a critical role in delivering personalized, long-term care for the patients we serve.

With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials.

If you’re interested in meaningful work with impact, explore our career opportunities and join us in our purpose of Bringing Care To Life™.

**The anticipated salary range for this position is $21.56 - $23.05 hourly. The actual compensation offered may vary based on job related factors such as experience, skills, education and location.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

Our Branch Coordinators positively impact the lives of patients and their caregivers, by phone and in person, delivering excellent customer service during each interaction. Working collaboratively with patients, providers and other team members, Branch Coordinators ensure orders are received and processed timely, efficiently, and accurately. Branch Coordinators play an important role in ensuring Apria is paid for the services we provide by obtaining all necessary documentation required to bill health insurance plans.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Act as first point of contact to patients arriving in person.
* Answer inbound calls from customers on a multi-line phone system; provide information to new and existing patients, troubleshoot common issues, work with the branch team and other departments to find appropriate resolutions and escalate queries or concerns when necessary.
* Perform processing duties for the branch; including, but not limited to, creating, and working with new orders, reviewing multiple systems simultaneously to assist customers, confirming delivery appointments, verifying insurance, obtaining authorization of equipment based on payor guidelines, monitoring incoming faxes, and performing data entry.
* Work with sales team, referrals and/or patients to gather documentation/information needed to meet insurance guidelines. Requests health plan authorizations/information as required; either electronically or verbally.
* Review of new and recurring patient accounts, obtain all necessary documentation from the referral source to bill the individual health insurance plans, allowing our patients to maximize their available health plan benefits and to receive the much-needed care as soon as possible.
* Collect credit card payments and billing information, reconcile daily receivables, and submit to the lock box.
* Perform outbound customer satisfaction calls to patients and referrals.
* May conduct downloads of recording devices such as apnea monitors, oximeters, CPAP devices and other respiratory equipment.
* May perform functional tests on certain respiratory equipment.
* Performs other duties as required.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* None

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  

**Education and/or Experience**

* High School Diploma or equivalent
* At least one-year related work experience

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations or Professional Designations**

* None

**SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES**

* Organizing
* Problem Solving/Analysis
* Patient Focused
* Teamwork
* Time Management/Multi-tasking
* Effective communication in person, on the phone and electronically

**Computer Skills**

* Intermediate to advanced computer skills
* Proficient working within multiple systems at once

**Language Skills**

* English (reading, writing, verbal)

**Mathematical Skills**

* Intermediate level math skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

**Education and/or Experience**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee uses his/her hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, or crouch; talk or hear.

* Regularly required to read documents and write neatly, legibly and transcribe accurate information and numbers/values.

Work is performed in an office setting with exposure to moderate noise and indoor florescent lighting.

As an Accendra Health employee, you have choices to fit your life. Our comprehensive benefits program is designed to meet you where you are — through all of life’s stages. We’ve got you and your family covered with benefits that support your health, finances, and overall wellness.

**Who We Are****:**

At Synapse Health, we're streamlining the durable medical equipment (DME) process. We manage intake, documentation, routing, claims, billing, and patient support. Our model reshapes how DME is delivered and experienced.

Since 2016, with decades of industry and leadership experience, we've delivered tech-based solutions that help our partners to modernize operations, improve coordination, and reduce administrative burdens. By taking on operational and financial complexity, we're redefining how DME works for providers, prescribers, and patients. We are proud to offer ***work that matters, on a mission that*** ***matter******s*****.**

*Learn**more at*SynapseHealth.com*and on*Synapse Health's LinkedIn*.*

**What We Need****:**

The ***Specialist, Member Transitions*** reports directly to the Manager, Member Transitions and plays a vital role within the Patient Transitions Department. In this role, you serve as the voice of Synapse Health for patients, prescribers, payors, and vendor partners throughout complex transition events. You ensure transitions are executed accurately, efficiently, and compassionately while delivering an exceptional member experience.

As a Specialist, Member Transitions, you are responsible for managing end-to-end transition workflows, including order accuracy, qualification and documentation review, authorization coordination, patient financial responsibility, and vendor equipment transitions. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment and embrace change as systems, processes, and programs evolve to support organizational growth.

* Insurance eligibility verification
* Retrieval and review of qualifying clinical documentation per payor guidelines
* Authorization and pre-determination coordination
* Patient financial responsibility collection
* Scheduling, care coordination, and prescriber/payor outreach
* Processing equipment returns, exchanges, and service transitions
* Coordinate member transitions with partner vendors and communicate transition details with members, care teams, and internal departments.
* Provide timely updates on authorization status and transition progress to members, vendors, and providers.
* Deliver accurate information related to new orders, resupplies, pickups, services, and exchanges.

* Ensure compliance with all quality, regulatory, payor, and state requirements.

* Partner with department leaders on special projects and process improvement initiatives.
* Participate in an on-call rotation to support after-hours member requests.
* Perform additional duties as required to support team and organizational objectives.

At Synapse Health, we've intentionally built a culture rooted in kindness, collaboration, and creativity, qualities we consider essential for every team member. Additional requirements include:

* 2+ years of recent experience in the durable medical equipment (DME) industry, including customer service, qualifications, logistics, patient transitions, or related roles.

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage complex, high-volume workflows.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills across multiple audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to navigate complex transitions and resolve issues.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy and compliance.

**What Sets You Apart****:**

* Strategic Thinker: Understands the broader transition lifecycle and anticipates downstream impacts.
* Adaptable: Responds quickly to change and embrace new processes, systems, and workflows.
* Analytical: Breaks down complex information to draw clear, actionable conclusions.
* Sound Decision-Maker: Exercises good judgment in high-pressure or complex situations while maintaining a patient-first mindset.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with computers, has an interest in design, and likes helping customers solve problems.

You'll work directly with customers and our internal team to assist with closet layouts, make design adjustments, answer product questions, and provide support using **Closet Pro**, our online closet design software.

We're looking for someone who is dependable, eager to learn, comfortable with technology, and takes pride in providing excellent customer service.

f9b629adf5d993ecf796.description:
Total Comp: Total expected earnings (base + commissions) starting at $60K–$80K, with very high growth potential.

#### **About DEO**

DEO (Dentist Entrepreneur Organization) helps dental practice owners transition from burned-out operators to empowered CEOs. We coach entrepreneurial dentists scaling multi-location practices to achieve true freedom, legacy, and profitability — without sacrificing quality of care or quality of life. Join a movement that's reshaping the dental industry through leadership, systems, and strategy.

#### **The Role**

You are the connective tissue between marketing and sales. Your primary job is to make sure the right dentists show up to their discovery calls at the right time, and that our sales team can live in clean calendars instead of drowning in admin.

Although this is not a high-volume cold-calling role where you are dialing 100-200 times a day, you must be super comfortable on the phone as you will often need to call dentists' cell phones and office phones to confirm their appointments. You’ll confirm and manage calls that are already being booked, own our SMS inbox, and keep our CRM and calendars accurate. You’ll also re-engage warm and past leads so opportunities don’t slip through the cracks.

This role is part sales/SDR and part administrative support.

Important: This position rewards tenacity. We are looking for someone who is willing and excited to answer a text from a prospect that comes in at 7 PM or on a weekend because it means they might make more commission.

#### **What You’ll Do**

* Respond to every new inbound lead by phone, text, and email within minutes to confirm they will attend their discovery call
* Own our inbound and outbound call and text software (Sendblue) and ensure no message falls through the cracks
* Run confirmation and reminder processes (automated and manual) to maximize show rates
* Scrub and manage the sales calendars:
* Confirm upcoming calls
* Move/update meetings when prospects reschedule
* Clear out unconfirmed or lowquality appointments
* Manage our inbound SMS channel during business hours and be willing to respond to highintent prospects outside normal hours when needed (and rewarded)
* Reengage past leads, including noshows, lost deals, and older inquiries, in small focused batches
* Take detailed notes and disposition every contact attempt in the CRM
* Support sales administration: update calendars, move deals to the correct stages, log outcomes, and keep the pipeline clean
* Participate in regular roleplay and call reviews to sharpen your communication and confirmation scripts

#### **How Success Is Measured**

* Number of qualified appointments that show
* Overall show rate on booked calls you touch
* Reactivation revenue from past leads brought back to the table
* Clean, accurate CRM and calendars where every lead has a clear next step
* Speed to lead (how quickly you handle requests)

#### **What You Bring**

* 1+ year in an inbound or outbound SDR, appointment setter, coordinator, project manager, or phonebased role
* Comfort with utilizing AI and LLM's beyond using them as a search engine (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.). We are very AIforward, and we are always looking for ways to have AI help us build and support our systems.
* Comfort with steady call/text volume and structured followup checklists
* Clear, concise communication skills with a confident phone presence and strong writing

4ea8895ba3ea8ee350f3.description:
**Join AIR as a part-time Project Support Associate and use your experience and skills to help advance our mission: to generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.**

The Project Support Associate provides administrative, research, logistical, and production support to ensure the successful delivery of projects across AIR's higher education in prison (HEP) technical assistance portfolio. This role helps coordinate national convenings and communities of practice, supports the development and dissemination of field-facing resources, and assists with the day-to-day operations that keep collaborative work moving forward.

Working closely with AIR staff and a diverse network of external partners, the Project Support Associate helps organize information, facilitate communications, and guide resources from draft development through public release. This position is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, collaborative, and skilled at managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

This position has the flexibility to work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of our U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.

#### **About AIR:**

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

**Responsibilities:**

The responsibilities for the position include:

* Coordinate logistics for meetings, recurring virtual convenings, and working sessions, including scheduling, calendar management, registration, attendance tracking, and follow-up.
* Organize and prepare meeting materials, including agendas, pre-reading, and supporting documents, and distribute notes, minutes, and identified next steps afterward.
* Capture notes during meetings and working sessions and translate raw notes and transcripts into concise summaries, decision records, and action item lists for follow-up.
* Support research activities, including literature reviews, environmental scans, resource inventories, and compiling reference lists to inform priorities.
* Route draft materials through internal quality assurance and review processes, and perform quality control reviews to ensure consistency and accuracy.
* Track deliverables, assignments, timelines, and milestones across multiple concurrent workstreams, monitoring progress and flagging risks to schedules.
* Maintain and develop processes, procedures, and tracking tools for administrative and project support, including planning and scheduling.
* Maintain project documentation, records, shared file structures, and version control across concurrent workstreams.
* Support the onboarding of new participants and partners, and assist project leadership teams with communication activities.
* Provide administrative support to senior staff and project leaders, including calendar scheduling and meeting coordination, and general coordination support to the project team. Perform other duties as assigned.
* Monitor and report on progress, deliverable status, and feedback, and participate in team meetings and project planning.

**Qualifications:**

**Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

* HS diploma and 2+ years of relevant experience, or Bachelor's degree.
* Office or project management experience, preferably supporting technical assistance, research, or convening work.
* Understanding of project management principles and practices, including tracking deliverables across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Experience coordinating virtual convenings, working groups, advisory bodies, or communities of practice.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint), Microsoft Teams, and Windows-based work environments; experience with Airtable and SharePoint.
* Interest in or familiarity with higher education in prison, correctional education, postsecondary access, or reentry preferred; direct expertise is not required.

**Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Microsoft Teams, including scheduling and file management in SharePoint.
* Familiarity with virtual convening platforms, including registration, polling, and transcription features.
* Ability to synthesize discussion into clear, concise notes, summaries, and action items.
* Ability to focus on details within complex documents or organizational systems, with strong accuracy in tracking review cycles and version control across collaboratively developed materials.
* Excellent proofreading, language, and analytic skills.
* Efficient and accurate writing skills.
* Ability to organize work and follow through independently.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and to coordinate across multiple external partner organizations, adapting communication to varied audiences.
* Customer service-oriented mindset.
* Effective communication skills with the ability to collaborate efficiently in a virtual work environment.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to adapt to changing deadlines and manage competing priorities across concurrent workstreams.

**Disclosures:** Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis. Employment-based visa sponsorship (including H-1B sponsorship) is not available for this position. Depending on project work, qualified candidates may need to meet certain residency requirements.

American Institutes for Research is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law, including, but not limited to, actual or perceived race (including traits historically associated with race, such as hair texture, hair type, and protective hairstyles such as braid, locs, and twists), creed, color, religion, alienage or national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition (e.g., cancer), sex, gender, gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, civil union status, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, genetic information, or military or veteran status. AIR adheres to strict child safeguarding principles. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to these standards and principles and will therefore undergo reference and background checks. AIR maintains a drug-free work environment.

**ACCESSIBILITY NOTICE:** If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process due to a physical or mental disability, please send an email to Taliba Boone at tboone@air.org or call 202.403.5000.

5903b31741413f9f52a2.title: Patient Access Coordinator - Reception
5903b31741413f9f52a2.description:
Description:

**Position Summary**

Berks Ortho is seeking dependable, detail-oriented, and team-focused Patient Access Coordinators to support a welcoming, accurate, and efficient patient experience across orthopedic, radiology, and physical therapy services. Patient Access Coordinators serve as an important administrative connection between patients, providers, clinical staff, and other practice functions. Each coordinator has a defined primary assignment while remaining part of a collaborative, cross-trained Patient Access team.

**Why This Role Matters**

Patient Access is where the patient experience and many of the practice's most important administrative workflows begin. Accurate scheduling, registration, insurance information, communication, and follow-through help patients receive the right care without unnecessary delays while supporting efficient clinical operations and accurate billing. Every Patient Access team member is expected to combine excellent service with accuracy, ownership, and appropriate follow-through.

**Shared Patient Access Responsibilities**

* Provide consistently excellent service with kindness, patience, professionalism, and respect.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation in Epic and follow established Patient Access workflows.
* Protect patient confidentiality and comply fully with HIPAA and practice privacy requirements.
* Communicate clearly with patients, providers, clinical staff, and coworkers and make appropriate handoffs when an issue belongs to another function.
* Participate in departmental huddles, training, and cross-training activities.
* Maintain reliable attendance and punctuality and contribute to appropriate coverage of Patient Access operations.
* Support interpreter services and patient accessibility needs when required.
* Assist with other Patient Access functions as trained and as patient volume, staffing, and operational needs require.

**Primary Responsibilities - Reception**

* Greet and check in patients for orthopedic, radiology, and physical therapy appointments and create a warm, professional first impression.
* Own front-end registration accuracy by collecting, reviewing, and verifying patient demographic and insurance information and addressing missing or inconsistent information whenever possible before the patient progresses through the visit.
* Complete insurance pre-registration and support accurate patient records in Epic.
* Collect copayments and other point-of-service payments and manage the daily cash drawer with accuracy and integrity.
* Coordinate patient arrival and check-in with clinical and administrative teams to support smooth patient flow.
* Support patient records workflows assigned to Reception, including receipt, routing, scanning, or other handling in accordance with practice procedures.
* Assist patients physically present at the front desk with questions and appropriately route or escalate matters that cannot be resolved at the point of contact.
* Provide reasonable cross-coverage for Scheduling and Check Out workflows as trained. Reception is not the primary owner of the shared inbound phone queue.

Requirements:

**Cross-Coverage and Team Expectations**

Primary assignment establishes day-to-day ownership; it does not limit teamwork. Patient Access operates as a collaborative team. Coordinators are expected to understand how Reception, Scheduling, and Check Out connect, maintain competency in cross-covered workflows as trained, and help patients reach the appropriate next step rather than simply redirecting an issue. Specialized authorization and surgical workflows should be handed off to the appropriate designated role.

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or GED.
* Prior customer service experience; medical office experience preferred.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage patient information accurately.
* Ability to work effectively in a team-based, fast-paced environment.
* Comfort with basic computer systems and ability to learn Epic EMR workflows.
* Commitment to punctuality, discretion, and patient confidentiality.
* Clear criminal background check and child abuse clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using Epic or another electronic health record (EHR) system.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish.
* Familiarity with basic medical terminology and insurance processes.

**Work Schedule and Physical Requirements**

Full-time and part-time shifts may be available. Most work occurs during standard weekday hours, with occasional shifts ending as late as 7:30 PM planned in advance. Weekend shifts are not required at this time. The role involves sitting and standing in a busy office environment and occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.

**Additional Notes**

Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the practice grows and operational needs change. Berks Ortho reserves the right to modify this job description as needed. Berks Ortho is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals in accordance with applicable law.

**Why Join Berks Ortho?**

At Berks Ortho, every team member is part of something greater. We believe in delivering high-quality care through collaboration, compassion, professionalism, and continuous improvement. Patient Access plays a critical role in ensuring patients feel seen, supported, and well cared for while also helping the practice operate accurately and efficiently.

**Company Description**

Help patients access the care they need by making appointment scheduling and coordination easier. In this military healthcare environment, you'll be a key point of contact for patients arranging primary care, specialty referrals, and follow-up appointments.

At International SOS Government Medical Services, you'll support healthcare programs that improve patient care and operational readiness across the U.S. and internationally. Founded in 1984, International SOS operates in more than 90 countries, delivering healthcare, medical assistance, emergency response, and workforce support services worldwide.

 **Job Description**

In this role, you'll support patient appointment services within a centralized healthcare call center serving military beneficiaries. You'll handle incoming and outgoing calls, coordinate primary and specialty care appointments, and help patients navigate scheduling requests and next steps.

Your work will involve electronic healthcare systems, including MHS GENESIS, to maintain accurate appointment information, process requests, and support timely access to care.

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Residence Requirement:** Candidate must reside within 50 miles of San Antonio, TX.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* $17.10–$18.00 per hour
* Health and Welfare (H&W) benefit of up to $5.09 per hour, in accordance with the Service Contract Act (SCA).

**Schedule:** Full-time, with varying shifts Monday–Friday between 6:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. Pacific Time, including rotating Saturday or Sunday shifts every other weekend between 7:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time. Candidates must be available to work any assigned shift within these hours. Overtime may be required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate appointments: Schedule, reschedule, and cancel primary and specialty care appointments, including correcting booking errors.
* Assist patients: Handle inbound and outbound calls, answer scheduling questions, and work toward resolving inquiries during the initial call.
* Verify information: Confirm patient eligibility, update demographic information, and maintain accurate appointment records.
* Support specialty care: Coordinate referral appointments, preventive care scheduling, and patient reminders, including pre-appointment instructions.
* Manage electronic requests: Process secure messages, document interactions in MHS GENESIS, and prepare patient notification letters.
* Collaborate across teams: Work with healthcare departments and administrative teams to support scheduling accuracy, service standards, and patient access.

  
**Qualifications**

**Requirements**

* High school diploma or GED equivalent.
* Basic computer skills and the ability to learn and use Microsoft 365 applications, including Teams, Excel, and Outlook, along with other required computer systems and technologies.
* Ability to provide courteous, professional customer service to internal and external customers and communicate effectively by telephone, verbally, and in writing, including handling or routing calls and inquiries.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, organize priorities, and complete assigned tasks accurately within required timeframes while maintaining records and documentation.
* Ability to follow established procedures and instructions and seek assistance or clarification when needed.

  
**Additional Information**

**Privacy Disclaimer:** **Policy Link**

By clicking “I’m Interested” and submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood the applicable Privacy Policy (available via the link above) and agree that International SOS Government Medical Services, may collect, use, store, transfer, and otherwise process your personal information in accordance with that Privacy Policy for recruitment and hiring purposes.

**Compensation Disclaimer:**  
Pay range is based on several factors and may vary in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Final salary and offer will be determined by the applicant’s background, experience, skills, internal equity, and alignment with geographical market data.

**Benefits Language (FTE roles):**  
Full-time positions are eligible for our comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k plan, paid time off, and an annual bonus. International SOS Government Medical Services complies with all federal, state, and local minimum wage laws.

**Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO) Statement:**  
International SOS Government Medical Services is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against employees or job applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

429d636c9c10f352cc29.description:
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Schedule up to 300 MRI department patient appointments per week
* Understand scheduling rules for MRI scheduling- 1.5T vs 3
* Screen patients for metal, pacemakers, etc.. during scheduling
* Perform a variety of scheduling duties via telephone, fax, and health information exchange
* Answer incoming phone calls
* Coordinate and confirm MRI appointment times
* Answer patient questions and directing calls and messages to the appropriate personnel
* Obtain proper documentation for appointments
* Maintain patient confidence and protect operations by keeping information confidential
* Report to the office location, as needed
* Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as deemed appropriate

  

**GENERAL COMPENTENCIES DESIRED**

  

* Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently, with minimal supervision.
* Excellent organizational, communication skills, telephone, and exceptional customer service skills.
* Ability to interact effectively with patients and co-workers and possess excellent listening and interpretive skills.
* Ability to be comfortable in learning and using digital tools.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, remaining calm and helpful under pressure and emergency situations.
* PC skills required with a typing speed of approximately 35 wpm.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

Requires eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity necessary for operation of basic office equipment such as computer terminal and telephone. Requires use of the telephone. Must have a high school diploma or equivalent education and at least one year experience in a medical setting or customer service field.

**HOURS: MONDAY-FRIDAY**

**Description**

Your passion belongs at UNC Health. Join more than 56,000 teammates working together to improve the health and well-being of the communities we serve across North Carolina.

**Summary:**  
This role is responsible in ensuring that patient access processing is performed in accordance with procedure and documented in a timely and accurate manner in ADT and other clinical information systems. Meets departmental/organizational outcome targets  
for process accuracy and timeliness.

**Responsibilities:**  
Ensures and verifies key ADT information (insurance verification, patient and guarantor demographics, etc.) is current and accurate to ensure patient safety, charging, coding, insurance processing, and billing accuracy.  
Schedules all new and follow-up patient appointments as required. Attempt to reschedule cancellations whenever possible. Communicates cancellations to provider as necessary.  
Completes and documents all governmental, regulatory, financial, and contractual forms in accordance to procedure. Ensures document is scanned/saved to correct location and is legible.  
Utilizes price estimation tool, when applicable, as part of the registration process to provide the most accurate estimate to patients  
Meets departmental target for up front collections to include deposits, estimated amounts due, co-pays, and/or prior balances.  
Actively participates in departmental QA by utilizing system work queues, making a personal effort to reduce individual errors, and making corrections. Utilizes system work queues as a daily part of the registration process to minimize errors.

**Professional Experience Requirements:**

=====================================================================================

**Exemption Status:**

Non-Exempt

Monday through Friday

**Shift:**

1 - Day Shift, 8 Hours (United States of America)

**Hours:**

40

**Cost Center:**

99940 - 5492 Patient Access Center

**Union:**

SHARE (State Healthcare and Research Employees)

This position may have a signing bonus available a member of the Recruitment Team will confirm eligibility during the interview process.

**Everyone Is a Caregiver**
===========================

At UMass Memorial Health, everyone is a caregiver – regardless of their title or responsibilities. Exceptional patient care, academic excellence and leading-edge research make UMass Memorial the premier health system of Central Massachusetts, and a place where we can help you build the career you deserve. We are more than 20,000 employees, working together as one health system in a relentless pursuit of healing for our patients, community and each other. And everyone, in their own unique way, plays an important part, every day.

The role of the Patient Access Scheduling Agent is the front door for patients to secure access to the right care, at the right time, with the right provider. The Patient Access Scheduling agent performs a variety of complex scheduling activities that ensures patients get access to the care they need by providing exceptional patient service.

I. Major Responsibilities:
  
1. Handles incoming phone calls from patients, families and referring providers to schedule patient appointments. Scheduling scope includes multiple providers across multiple clinics/departments, practices across multiple campuses.
  
2. Makes outbound phone calls to patients to schedule appointments with specialists and subspecialists.
  
3. As part of the appointment scheduling process, secure the information needed to facilitate the financial aspects of medical care such as patient demographics (name, date of birth, etc.), insurance information, and account guarantor. Processes updates and corrections to patient insurance and demographic information. Collects patient liabilities prior to or on the date of service, as appropriate.
  
4. Based upon appointment visit type, secure medical records from outside health care organizations to ensure the provider has the necessary medical information to provide care.
  
5. Schedules in office procedures (such as biopsies, etc.), which often requires scheduling the appointment and scheduling the room where the procedure will take place.

II. Position Qualifications:

License/Certification/Education:
  
Required:
  
1. High school diploma.

Preferred:
  
1. Associate’s degree in business or healthcare-related field.

Experience/Skills:
  
Required:
  
1. English speaking, reading and writing skills.
  
2. Strong intrapersonal and communication skills.

Preferred:
  
1. Previous scheduling and/or phone customer services experience.
  
2. Previous experience in a health care organization.
  
3. Bilingual speaking, reading, and writing skills.

Unless certification, licensure or registration is required, an equivalent combination of education and experience which provides proficiency in the areas of responsibility listed in this description may be substituted for the above requirements.

Department-specific competencies and their measurements will be developed and maintained in the individual departments. The competencies will be maintained and attached to the departmental job description. Responsible managers will review competencies with position incumbents.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

We’re striving to make respect a part of everything we do at UMass Memorial Health – for our patients, our community and each other. Our six Standards of Respect are: Acknowledge, Listen, Communicate, Be Responsive, Be a Team Player and Be Kind. If you share these Standards of Respect, we hope you will join our team and help us make respect our standard for everyone, every day.

As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, UMass Memorial Health recognizes the power of a diverse community and encourages applications from individuals with varied experiences, perspectives and backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at talentacquisition@umassmemorial.org. We will make every effort to respond to your request for disability assistance as soon as possible.

64c1e99a7402a876af5b.title: Food Service Operations Coordinator
64c1e99a7402a876af5b.description:
Job Summary

Bad Brother is seeking a **Food Service Operations Coordinator** to support daily restaurant operations, coordinate food service activities, and maintain efficient workflows across kitchen and front-of-house teams. This role assists with staff coordination, inventory monitoring, service quality, operational records, and customer service to help ensure smooth restaurant operations and a positive guest experience.

Common Job Roles

* Food Service Operations Coordinator
* Restaurant Operations Coordinator
* Food Service Coordinator
* Restaurant Operations Specialist
* Hospitality Operations Coordinator

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate daily food service activities and restaurant workflows.
* Communicate operational updates between kitchen staff, service teams, and management.
* Assist with staff scheduling, shift coordination, and task assignments.
* Monitor service operations to help maintain quality and efficiency standards.
* Support inventory tracking, supply ordering, and receiving activities.
* Coordinate food preparation and order fulfillment with kitchen team members.
* Help maintain consistent food quality, presentation, and service standards.
* Respond to routine customer concerns and coordinate follow-up when needed.
* Maintain accurate operational records, reports, and administrative documentation.
* Assist with employee onboarding, training coordination, and team communication.
* Monitor food service supplies and report shortages or operational issues.
* Help coordinate opening, closing, and routine restaurant procedures.
* Follow food safety, sanitation, hygiene, and workplace safety requirements.
* Perform additional food service and operational duties assigned by management.

Requirements

* High school diploma or equivalent preferred; hospitality or business education is an asset.
* Previous restaurant, food service, hospitality, or operations experience is preferred.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Basic computer, spreadsheet, and recordkeeping proficiency.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Professional attitude and strong teamwork skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with employees, managers, and customers.
* Flexible availability for assigned shifts, including evenings and weekends when required.

Preferred Skills

* Experience coordinating restaurant or food service operations.
* Familiarity with POS, inventory, scheduling, or restaurant management systems.
* Knowledge of food service workflows and customer service standards.
* Strong time management and multitasking abilities.
* Understanding of food safety and sanitation procedures.
* Good conflict-resolution and communication skills.
* Ability to identify workflow issues and support operational improvements.

About the Company

Bad Brother operates in the restaurant and hospitality industry, where organized food service, reliable teamwork, and attentive customer care are essential to daily operations. The restaurant team focuses on food quality, efficient service, cleanliness, and a welcoming dining experience.

Pay: $19.00 - $24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 37.0 per week

Work Location: In person

8b8668a768d226ed7185.title: Training Coordinator
8b8668a768d226ed7185.description:
It’s great to work at a place where people are truly committed to serving our students! We’re committed to bringing passion and energy to our College.

Visit our Life Page on LinkedIn to explore our dynamic campus culture, hear from current employees, and discover what makes Bucks County Community College a great place to work!

This position is responsible for coordinating on-site and off-site public safety training programs; selecting and scheduling adjunct instructors; evaluating instructor performance; and managing required course equipment, resources, and materials. The position also oversees support staff responsible for coordinating, processing, and documenting all information related to on-site and off-site operations.

This position reports directly to the Director of Operations. Additional assignments may be assigned by the Executive Director of Public Safety. The incumbent will actively participate in strategic planning and administrative support initiatives.

This position requires a responsible, self-motivated individual who can serve as a leader in a high-volume, fast-paced office environment. The successful candidate must be flexible in work scheduling, capable of multitasking, able to work effectively amid frequent interruptions, and committed to meeting established deadlines for assigned tasks.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Coordinating on-site and off-site public safety training courses for emergency services organizations.
* Select qualified and certified adjunct instructors for training courses.
* Manage office operations at the training facility.
* Manage the support staff at the training facility.
Perform special projects as assigned.  

  

**SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITY**

Proctor and evaluate certification examinations as requested.  

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* High school diploma or general equivalency diploma (GED) and three years of work experience, or an associate degree.
* 4 - 6 years of job-related experience in customer service.
* Knowledge of FERPA regulations, policies, and procedures, and of the State Training System as defined by the Office of the State Fire Commissioner. Experience with the PA Public Safety Training System and professional certification testing.
* Management and customer service skills.
* Good interpersonal skills.
* Basic skills in Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Basic project management skills.
* Valid driver's license.
* All office staff must have Child Abuse Clearance due to their interaction with minors in relation to courses.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Demonstrated flexibility and adaptability for off-site training and testing opportunities.
* Strong organizational and detail-oriented skills.
* Experience with the Colleague database.
* Good problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work in an active environment with constant interruptions.
* Effective communication skills with a diverse student and instructor population.
* Capacity to manage a heavy workload.
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude when dealing with agitated students and/or instructors.
* Proficiency in multitasking.
* Ability to move and set up various training props and tools.

**Salary Range** $50,618 - 64,630 (commensurate with experience)

  

**Benefits**

Bucks County Community College offers an exceptional benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, prescription plans, 403B pension plan, life insurance, short & long-term disability, generous paid time off, tuition waivers, tuition assistance, wellness center, cafeteria, and free parking on a beautiful Bucks County campus.

**Background Checks/Clearances**

Employment with the College will require successful completion of background check(s) in accordance with the College's policies, including a Pennsylvania Background Check, FBI Fingerprint Clearance, and Pennsylvania Child Abuse History Clearance.

**Application**

Apply online at: https://bucks.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/BCCC

Applications must consist of a letter of application addressing this specific position and the candidate’s interest and qualifications for coming to Bucks County Community College, resume/CV, and professional references. References will not be contacted without prior permission. Finalists may be asked to provide additional materials.

**Deadline**

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

We are proud to be an organization that embraces the value of bringing diverse, talented, and committed people together. The fastest way to breakthrough innovation is when diverse ideas come together in an inclusive environment. We encourage our colleagues to respectfully challenge one another’s thinking and approach problems collectively. We are an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Please Note: At this time, the College does not provide work visa sponsorships. To be considered for employment at Bucks County Community College, applicants must be permitted to legally work in the United States without employer sponsorship. *Bucks County Community College participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.*

8475b8d4e8e1f5e477bb.title: Logistics Coordinator
8475b8d4e8e1f5e477bb.description:
**Logistics Coordinator (Remote)**

**Location:** Remote, United States (Eastern and Central Time zones)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reports To:** Procurement Manager  
**Salary Range:** $65,000 – $75,000 annually

*Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and internal equity.*

**About the Opportunity**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized **Logistics Coordinator** to support procurement, transportation, and supply chain operations across our business. This role is responsible for coordinating shipments, maintaining accurate records, communicating with suppliers and carriers, and ensuring products move efficiently from origin to destination.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving problems, and excels at keeping multiple priorities organized while delivering exceptional customer service.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate domestic inbound and outbound shipments from order release through final delivery.
* Schedule shipments and deliveries with suppliers, carriers, warehouses, and internal stakeholders.
* Monitor shipment status, proactively identify delays or issues, and communicate updates and resolution plans.
* Prepare and maintain shipping documentation, purchase order records, tracking information, and logistics files.
* Verify freight charges, assist with invoice reconciliation, and escalate discrepancies as needed.
* Maintain accurate data within ERP, inventory, transportation, and carrier management systems.
* Support inventory visibility, procurement activities, and supplier relationships.
* Track logistics performance metrics and identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Respond promptly to internal and external customer inquiries.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and operational standards.

**Qualifications Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in logistics, transportation, shipping, procurement, order management, or a related coordination role.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy and attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* Experience with ERP, TMS, WMS, or carrier management systems.
* Knowledge of shipping documentation, inventory management, and transportation processes.

**Remote Work Expectations**

* Maintain a reliable high-speed internet connection and dedicated workspace.
* Be available during standard business hours and responsive through company communication tools.
* Participate in virtual meetings and collaborate effectively across multiple time zones.
* Occasional travel to company, supplier, warehouse, or customer locations may be required.

**Why Join Us?**

You'll play an important role in keeping our supply chain running smoothly while working with a collaborative team focused on operational excellence, customer service, and continuous improvement.

**Our Core Values**

We believe in:

* Integrity
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork
* Respect for People
* Accountability
* Open Communication
* Continuous Improvement

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the hiring process and during employment.

97cc38a96ed1f088a419.title: IT Operations & Onboarding Coordinator
97cc38a96ed1f088a419.description:
**About Blueprint**

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you'll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You'll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

**Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.**

**About the Role**
------------------

In this role, As a Vendor Onboarding & SAW Administrator, you will oversee the end-to-end onboarding and administrative support of external vendors, ensuring they have the equipment, system access, and compliance approvals required to perform their work. You will manage the lifecycle of Secure Admin Workstations (SAWs) and related security devices, coordinate account provisioning and equipment logistics, and track onboarding requirements from initial intake through completion. Working closely with vendors, managers, engineering teams, procurement, and support organizations across multiple time zones, you will maintain accurate records, resolve administrative and basic technical issues, manage outstanding requests, and proactively address compliance gaps. Your work will help streamline onboarding operations, maintain security and compliance standards, and allow technical teams to focus on their core responsibilities.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

Manage end-to-end vendor onboarding, from initial intake and documentation through account provisioning, equipment delivery, and handoff to the appropriate technical team.

* Administer Secure Admin Workstations (SAWs), including request coordination, setup, shipment tracking, returns, replacements, and ongoing lifecycle management.

* Coordinate the ordering, provisioning, shipping, and return of smartcards, card readers, security keys, and other required access devices.

* Submit, monitor, and follow up on external workforce records, background screenings, required training, purchase orders, organizational identifiers, and system access requests.

* Monitor and maintain vendor compliance records, including GOVID and SSPA status, and follow up on outstanding requirements and overdue attestations.

* Provide basic technical support for SAW onboarding, computer setup, and access-related issues, escalating complex problems to the appropriate support teams.

* Manage onboarding and SAW work queues by maintaining accurate status updates, reviewing aging requests, addressing backlogs, tracking dependencies, and escalating delays.

* Coordinate account reinstatements, onboarding holds, expired screenings, and re-onboarding activities in partnership with relevant HR and support teams.

* Maintain and update onboarding procedures and documentation to reflect process changes, operational requirements, and compliance standards.

* Coordinate with vendors, managers, engineering teams, procurement, mailrooms, and support organizations across U.S., EMEA, and APAC time zones.

* Maintain accurate and confidential records related to vendor onboarding, screening, equipment, account access, and compliance activities.

* Proactively communicate outstanding actions, deadlines, and compliance gaps to vendors and internal stakeholders to support timely res

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations, Human Resources, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.

* 3+ years of experience in IT administration, vendor onboarding, administrative operations, workforce coordination, procurement support, IT asset logistics, or a related function.

* 3+ years of experience with computer or workstation administration, preferably involving Secure Admin Workstations (SAWs) or similar enterprise-managed devices.

* Experience managing high-volume, multi-step workflows using ticketing systems, work-management platforms, or other tracking tools.

* Demonstrated project coordination and workflow management skills, including prioritization, status tracking, follow-up, escalation, and backlog management.

* Strong organizational, documentation, time-management, and stakeholder communication skills.

* Ability to manage sensitive personnel information, background screening records, account details, and access-related documentation with discretion.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple requests, competing priorities, and time-sensitive onboarding activities.

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment and coordinate effectively with stakeholders across multiple time zones.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold stakeholders accountable for outstanding actions and compliance requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience administering Secure Admin Workstations (SAWs), enterprise-managed computers, or other security-controlled endpoint environments.

* Familiarity with enterprise account provisioning, identity and access management, and secure device setup.

* Experience coordinating secure-device logistics, including smartcards, card readers, hardware security keys, equipment returns, and replacements.

* Knowledge of international shipping, customs documentation, and cross-border equipment logistics.

55537ed9b34aa92d01b5.title: Implementation Coordinator
55537ed9b34aa92d01b5.description:
At LinderConnect, we help businesses handle customer calls more efficiently through AI-powered communication tools. But before those tools can make a difference, someone needs to make sure everything is set up properly.

We're hiring an Implementation Coordinator to help new customers get started with our services.

You'll spend your time talking with customers, gathering the details we need, coordinating with our team, and making sure each setup moves forward without unnecessary complications.

We don't expect you to know everything about AI or telecommunications. We're looking for someone who's organized, comfortable learning new technology, and good at working with people.

What You'll Be Working On

* Help new customers through the setup and implementation process.
* Gather information about each customer's business, operating hours, and call-handling needs.
* Coordinate the setup of AI phone agents, call routing, and automated follow-up features.
* Schedule customer meetings and keep implementation timelines organized.
* Communicate with internal teams to make sure setup requirements are understood.
* Track outstanding tasks and follow up on missing information.

* Keep customers updated on progress and answer questions throughout the process.
* Maintain accurate customer records, setup notes, and project documentation.
* Help customers become familiar with their new communication tools.

What We're Hoping You Bring

At least **1–3 years of experience** in customer onboarding, project coordination, technical support, business operations, software services, or a similar role.

Experience with CRM systems, SaaS products, scheduling tools, or telecommunications is helpful, but not required.

Strong computer skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple customer accounts are important.
