* **Coordinate** operational support by ensuring accurate patient documentation, managing inventory and equipment resources, maintaining programmer software, and assisting with daily coverage logistics to meet customer and business needs.

* **Educate** physicians, hospital staff, office personnel, and field team members on CRM products, therapies, and solutions, while supporting the onboarding and development of new Clinical Specialists and Sales Representatives.

* **Collaborate** with sales leadership and field partners to understand customer needs, market dynamics, and the value of Medtronic CRM products and solutions.

* **Identify** customer opportunities, support purchase order activities, monitor competitive trends, and provide actionable feedback to help achieve sales objectives.

* **Travel** extensively within the assigned territory to support customer clinics, hospitals, and business meetings, with frequent independent driving – approximate 80% of the time

* **Perform** physical job requirements, including frequent two-handed lifting of up to **40 lbs.** , sitting, standing, and walking for **8+ hours per day** , and regularly bending, stooping, squatting, and maintaining balance.

* **Work** effectively in clinical environments with exposure to eye protection, infectious disease, and radiation, while wearing **7-9 lbs.** of lead for extended periods, utilizing computers and mobile devices, and maintaining the vision capabilities necessary to support patient care and field-based responsibilities.

12f695f536b646654c00.description:
***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

SOLV Energy is looking for a Software QA and Support Engineer to join our Software Engineering Team to ensure we are providing high-quality work and service to our (mostly internal) customers. We are seeking someone who will collaborate within the team to successfully coordinate with external teams, test our software solutions, and contribute to our culture of continuous improvement and growth.
  
  
Members of the Software Engineering team support our custom software for utility-scale construction management, data monitoring, analytics, and reporting.
  
  
This role is fully remote, or hybrid with regular office presence in San Diego, CA or Bend, Oregon. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Achieve an expert level understanding of our custom software system features, the design intent, integrations with other business platforms, and how the applications are utilized
* Prioritize and manage testing work independently using Jira, team tools, and release timelines
* Build understanding of intended feature behavior through self-directed exploration and direct coordination with developers and product team members
* Work together with other QA team members to coordinate functional, regression, negative, and ad-hoc testing
* Write comprehensive test cases to cover functional test scenarios
* Identify and drive opportunities to improve testing through automation, AI, and other innovations
* Build self-sufficiency in your test environment, including basic Git/GitHub skills to pull and run code locally
* Bring insights from training and communications to the Software Engineering team to support continuous process and product improvement
* Serve as first point of contact and 2nd-tier support for our custom software — troubleshoot and resolve where possible, or escalate to the Development Manager with a clear, reproducible bug report in Jira
* Monitor support channels and maintain clear, accurate ticket records from intake through resolution, meeting response-time expectations
* Identify recurring or common issues, document known fixes to reduce repeat tickets and support future self-service, and suggest improvements to address root causes
* Complete other responsibilities as assigned

**Key Competencies:**

* Demonstrated, exceptional organizational skills and an aptitude to learn
* Experience testing software applications, identifying bugs, validating features against product requirements
* Proficiency in Jira and Confluence
* Strong problem-solving ability and analytical skills
* Clear and concise communication resulting in the contribution to effective wikis, product requirements
* Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience providing end-user software support, including triage, troubleshooting, and ticket management
* Comfortable being the front-line contact for support requests, with a customer- service mindset
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent support requests without losing track of details

**Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:**

* B.S. in Engineering, Computer Science, or related
* Experience writing automated tests for Typescript or Python code bases
* 5+ years of software QA testing

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary

7c091a0b196586faf7f3.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
7c091a0b196586faf7f3.description:
Synergy Business Innovation & Solutions is a premier implementer of cutting-edge software solutions. Synergy brings the experience and expertise necessary to deliver capability that provides tangible ROI to our customers. Our core areas of expertise are in the fields of Digital Transformation, Cloud Solutions, SaaS and Low-Code/No-Code Solutions, Emerging Technologies, Data Analytics and Visualization, Information Assurance, and Business Process Re-Engineering.

Synergy offers its employees a generous portfolio of core and voluntary benefits including: group medical, dental, and vision insurance, company paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance, HSA, FSA, 401(k) with company match, PTO & Bonus Leave, 11 paid federal holidays, parental leave, tuition and training reimbursement, a referral bonus program, and well-being programs.

At Synergy, you’ll be challenged and given the opportunity to grow in your career path. In fact, growth is such a big deal to us that we have career mentors available for every employee, company-funded certification opportunities, education reimbursement, and a general open-door policy so that you have support when you need it. Our team is eager to learn, fast-paced, and quality-driven. If that sounds like you, Synergy has a position for you!

This position is designated as work-from-home.

**About the Role:**

Synergy is seeking a Quality Assurance Analyst/Tester. As a Quality Assurance Analyst, you will be performing functional testing and Integration Tests via a server-based application User Interface. The right candidate will have a working knowledge of software engineering concepts such as software development standards, quality assurance standards, and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). As a Quality Assurance Analyst you will be able to interpret requirements, develop test plans and test cases, and test software functionality. The role will ensure quality in the product development and participate in client engagements, along with improving product quality assurance practices and supporting business development activities.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Expert Software Quality Assurance Analyst.
* Provides technical leadership to junior QA analysts.
* Expert with testing tools and methodologies.
* Meeting with the software/product designers to determine quality assurance parameters.
* Defines test plan development guidelines, testing strategies and procedures.
* Exercises extensive professional experience and judgement to plan and accomplish goals.
* Ensuring the successful deployment of products into production with minimal deficiencies.
* Responding to requests from the design team and management.
* Support application deployments, testing activities, and production releases.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, architects, QA testers, and product stakeholders.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, testing artifacts, and implementation guides.
* Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Assist in mentoring junior team members and sharing knowledge across the scrum team.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Proven experience with functional, system, regression, and integration testing.
* Proven experience developing test cases from user stories.
* Ability to analyze a product for accurate Integration test scenarios.
* High-level analytical skills and a high level of attention to detail.
* Critical thinker.
* Proven experience with test management tools.
* Experience with a variety of SDLC and Agile methodologies required.
* Experience in testing of RESTful APIs, SOAP APIs, and/or web services.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to multi-task under tight deadlines and report status.
* Ability to document QA procedures for the team.
* Ability to validate the deployment of software releases.
* Proven experience in test planning (including data planning), test scheduling, and test evaluation.
* Management of defects within a corporate defect tracking system.
* Ability to obtain Security + Certification, if necessary.
* Ability to work in cross-functional teams including New Development and Production Support for field level incidents.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative Agile team environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform.
* Experience with model-driven apps in Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Experience using Jira.
* Experience supporting production applications and participating in troubleshooting and incident resolution activities.

**Education Requirements:**

* Preferred: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Citizenship & Clearance Requirements:**

* Required: US Citizen w/ Public Trust or ability to achieve Public Trust.

**Target Salary Range**

Compensation for roles at Synergy is determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to, the requirements of the role; level of experience; education and certifications; the individual’s combination of knowledge, skills, and abilities; as well as alignment with market data, federal and state laws, and other business and contract considerations. The estimated pay range for this position is: $80,000.00 – $95,000.00. The disclosed range has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case and represent just one component of Synergy’s total compensation package for employees.

**Candidate AI Policy**

Synergy is committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate evaluation process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited **unless permission is explicitly granted.** You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

***Synergy is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants for employment or its employees on the basis of age, race (including hair texture/style), creed, color, religion, religious creed, ancestry, national origin, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, sex, medical condition, pregnancy (childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), physical or mental disability, personal appearance, organ donation and hair length associated with race, genetic information or characteristics, family responsibilities, familial status, marital status, citizenship or immigration status, status as a victim of domestic violence, a sexual offense, or stalking, political affiliation, arrest records and criminal convictions, credit information, matriculation, homeless status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state and local law. Discrimination or harassment based upon these protected categories is expressly prohibited. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including job selection, assignment, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, discipline, and termination.***

08aad90411485e80ebab.title: Tax Reporting Test Analyst (CONTRACT) REMOTE
08aad90411485e80ebab.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Broadridge is Growing! We are seeking a **Tax Reporting Test Analyst** with financial services experience to support testing activities related to tax reporting initiatives, system enhancements, and regulatory changes. This role will combine tax reporting knowledge with hands-on testing, data validation, reconciliation, and defect management. The ideal candidate will have experience working with tax reporting systems and financial-services data and be able to validate end-to-end results from source/history data through core processing, tax form boxes, and final reporting outputs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute QA and UAT test scenarios and test cases, including functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, dress rehearsal, and production-validation testing.
* Apply tax reporting knowledge to understand expected processing results, identify appropriate test scenarios, and validate system behavior.
* Review business, functional, and tax reporting requirements and translate them into comprehensive testing scenarios and expected results.
* Identify required test populations, test data, expected results, dependencies, prerequisite processing, and testing coverage.
* Validate end-to-end tax data processing from transaction/history data through core tables, business-rule processing, tax form box calculations, and final reporting outputs.
* Perform detailed data validation and reconciliation to identify discrepancies between source/history data, processed data, expected results, and tax reporting outputs.
* Use SQL and Excel to research data, develop test populations, validate results, reconcile large datasets, and investigate testing discrepancies.
* Validate source-to-target mappings, file layouts, data transformations, calculations, tax business rules, reference data, and system configuration.
* Validate tax forms and reporting outputs against source data, expected results, documented requirements, and applicable tax reporting rules.
* Execute positive, negative, boundary, exception, and regression testing to confirm system functionality and identify unintended impacts.
* Identify and document defects in JIRA with clear reproduction steps, supporting data, expected results, and actual results.
* Manage defects through analysis, remediation, retesting, regression testing, and closure.
* Partner with Development, Product, Operations, QA, UAT, and Tax teams to investigate and resolve tax reporting, testing, and data discrepancies.
* Track test execution, defects, blockers, dependencies, and outstanding items through resolution.
* Maintain test cases, test evidence, reconciliation results, defect documentation, and supporting documentation required for implementation and production readiness.
* Support annual tax-year changes, regulatory updates, system migrations, conversions, dress rehearsals, and production implementations.

**Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in tax reporting, QA/UAT testing, tax data analysis, operations testing, or a similar role within financial services, with demonstrated experience combining tax domain knowledge and hands-on testing.
* Strong hands-on experience with QA and UAT testing, including functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, system-validation, and production-validation testing.
* Experience developing and executing detailed test scenarios, test cases, test data, and expected results.
* Experience performing end-to-end tax data testing across transaction/history data, core processing tables, tax form box calculations, and final reporting outputs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience working with large datasets, reconciliations, exception analysis, and root-cause investigation.
* Proficiency with SQL and Microsoft Excel for data validation, reconciliation, research, and testing.
* Strong hands-on experience with JIRA is required, including creating and managing defects, documenting expected and actual results, tracking issues through resolution, supporting retesting, and maintaining testing status and evidence.
* Experience validating source-to-target mappings, data transformations, calculations, business rules, file layouts, reference data, and system configuration.
* Strong experience identifying, documenting, tracking, retesting, and closing defects with clear reproduction steps and supporting data.
* Experience working with or testing tax reporting systems or tax data platforms is strongly preferred.
* Experience with tax information reporting, including Forms 5498, 5498-ESA, 1042-S, and 1099 reporting, is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with retirement reporting, NRA reporting, income reporting, withholding, brokerage transactions, and securities processing is preferred.
* Experience within brokerage, wealth management, banking, securities processing, asset servicing, or financial reporting environments.
* Experience with large-volume data reconciliation and comparison testing.
* Ability to independently manage assigned QA/UAT testing activities, reconciliations, defects, and test evidence through completion.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent testing priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail.
* Familiarity with Agile or hybrid project-delivery methodologies.

*Hourly range $60-70/hr*

b2ef2c23ec046a2ee35e.description:
Description:

**OVERVIEW**

The Accounts Receivable Specialist is responsible for managing customer accounts, ensuring timely collection of outstanding invoices, applying customer payments, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining accurate accounts receivable records. This position works closely with Sales, Customer Service, Operations, and Accounting to support strong customer relationships, maintain accurate account information, and maximize cash flow while minimizing bad debt exposure.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, and comfortable balancing collection efforts by maintaining positive, professional relationships with customers. Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills are important in this role. Previous experience in a manufacturing environment is preferred.

Reporting structure

* Reports To: Accounting Manager / Controller
* Department: Finance & Accounting
* FLSA Status: Exempt

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Accounts Receivable Management**

* Generate, distribute, and monitor customer invoices.
* Apply customer payments accurately and timely.
* Reconcile customer accounts and research discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate accounts receivable records and supporting documentation.
* Process credits, deductions, and adjustments in accordance with company policies.

**Collections and Cash Management**

* Monitor accounts receivable aging reports and proactively follow up on overdue balances.
* Contact customers regarding past-due invoices through phone, email, and written correspondence.
* Recommend payment arrangements to management when appropriate.
* Escalate delinquent accounts to management in accordance with established procedures.
* Support cash flow objectives through timely and consistent collection activities.

**Customer Account Support**

* Respond to customer inquiries regarding invoices, statements, payments, and account balances.
* Research and resolve payment disputes, pricing discrepancies, and billing issues.
* Collaborate with Sales, Customer Service, and Operations to resolve customer concerns that may impact payment.
* Maintain positive, professional customer relationships while consistently enforcing established payment terms.

Requirements:

**Reporting and Analysis**

* Prepare accounts receivable aging reports and collection status updates.
* Identify trends related to delinquent accounts and customer payment activity.
* Assist with month-end closing activities and account reconciliations.
* Support internal and external audit requests as needed.
* Provide information and recommendations to management related to past-due receivables and collection activities.

**Process Improvement**

* Assist with maintaining and improving accounts receivable processes, controls, and procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy, collection efficiency, and cash application processes.
* Support ERP system enhancements and other continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Manufacturing-Specific Experience**

* Understanding of customer purchase orders, sales orders, shipping documents, and invoicing processes.
* Familiarity with OEM, industrial, distribution, or contract manufacturing customers.
* Experience working with deductions related to freight claims, pricing disputes, returned goods, and quality issues.
* Knowledge of ERP systems such as Epicor, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, IQMS, Plex, or Infor.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong understanding of accounts receivable principles and collection practices.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to analyze account activity and identify discrepancies.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to professionally handle sensitive customer interactions.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)
* Percentage of past-due receivables
* Aging portfolio management

**Education**

* Associate degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 2-5 years of accounts receivable, collections, or accounting experience.
* Manufacturing industry experience preferred.
* Experience with ERP systems and accounting software.
* Experience managing a high-volume customer portfolio is preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Occasional lifting of office materials up to 20 pounds.
* Ability to communicate effectively by phone, video conference, and email.

**LOCATION**

* Remote - preference if located near one of our facilities

**SCHEDULE**

* M-F

**CADREX’S CORE VALUES**

* Safety first, rising to the challenge, collaboration, accountability, and doing the right thing

**ABOUT US**

CADREX Manufacturing Solutions is a leading provider of complex sheet metal and machined production parts, assemblies, and weldments for a variety of end markets, including electrical transmission and distribution, warehouse automation, technology, aerospace & defense, medical, food, and industrials. With locations in Colorado, Pennsylvania, Illinois, Washington, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Michigan, Indiana, Massachusetts, Oklahoma, and Monterrey Mexico, CADREX offers numerous in-house manufacturing capabilities, including laser cutting, sheet metal fabrication, complex assembly, CNC punching, CNC machining, forming, robotic welding, stamping, fastener insertion, and tool and die manufacturing, to effectively serve customers with lights-out manufacturing capabilities for mid- to high-volume production. For more information, visit www.cadrex.com.

215a4923a2f19add8d81.description:
**Syms Strategic Group (SSG)** is seeking a talented **Software Testing Principal (MUMPS)**  
**Location:** Remote  
**Department:** Veterans Affairs (VA)  
**Type:** Full Time  
**Min. Experience:** Experienced  
**Security Clearance Level:** Public Trust (MBI)  
**Salary Range:** $80,000 - $120,000  
***If you have previously applied to Syms Strategic Group (SSG), there is no need to reapply. Applications are still under review.***  
  
**Military Veterans are highly encouraged to apply!**  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

* Support testing and quality assurance activities for mission-critical healthcare applications operating in a MUMPS/InterSystems Cache environment
* Support modernization efforts, system enhancements, healthcare interoperability initiatives, and production support activities associated with legacy healthcare systems
* Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test procedures for healthcare applications operating in MUMPS/InterSystems Cache environments
* Validate software enhancements, maintenance releases, defect corrections, and system upgrades
* Support functional, integration, regression, user acceptance, system, and end-to-end testing activities
* Verify data integrity across legacy healthcare applications, databases, interfaces, and external systems
* Test healthcare interoperability transactions utilizing Health Level Seven (HL7), Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR), Electronic Data Interchanges (EDIs), and related industry standards
* Participate in Beta/IOC testing with healthcare facilities and end users, documenting results and coordinating issue resolution
* Analyze an troubleshoot software defects, integration failures, and production incidents
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, product owners, and end users to valid requirements and test objectives
* Develop test data and test environments supporting healthcare workflows and business processes
* Execute manual and automated testing activities where applicable
* Track, document, and communicate testing metrics, defects, risks, and status reports
* Validate integrations involving Veterans Health Information Systems and Technology Architecture (VistA), FileMan, healthcare messaging platforms, and external partner systems
* Support root cause analysis and verification of software fixes
* Review system requirements and technical specifications to ensure testability and complete coverage
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, procedures, and quality standards
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on testing strategies for healthcare and government systems

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

* Experience supporting healthcare, government, or other highly regulated environments
* Experience testing enterprise applications supporting clinical, benefits, or healthcare operations
* Experience supporting legacy applications and long-lived mission-critical systems
* Experience testing applications developed using MUMPS and/or InterSystems Cache
* Experience validating healthcare business workflows and system functionality
* Experience developing detailed test plans, test scenarios, test scripts, and test cases
* Experience performing functional, regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT)
* An understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies
* Experience validating database updates and data integrity
* An ability to analyze system logs, application errors, and test results to identify root causes
* Experience testing interfaces and system integrations
* Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards, including HL7, FHIR, and Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) EDI Transactions
* Experience validating EDI healthcare transactions, including 278 Prior Authorizations and 275 Attachments
* Experience utilizing defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, HP Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), and TestRail
* Experience creating testing metrics, dashboards, and status reports
* Strong documentation skills
* Knowledge of healthcare operational workflows
* Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems
* Experience supporting VistA environments
* Experience testing FileMan database functionality
* An understanding of healthcare regulatory and compliance requirements
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* An ability to work directly with business users and customers
* An ability to independently prioritize multiple activities
* Experience collaborating within cross-functional technical teams
* Strong attention to detail
* An ability to lead testing efforts and mentor junior testers
* Experience supporting production troubleshooting and issue resolution

  

**Professional Certifications**

n/a

  

**Years of Professional Experience**

10+ years of software testing, quality assurance, or system validation experience

  

**Desired experience**

Deep hands-on EDIFECS experience in Electronic Data Interchange X.12 (EDI) Transactions Standards involving key X12 workflows involving the following transactions:

* X.12 medical claims (837, 834, 835, 277, etc)
* 270/271 and 278/275 transactions
* 999 transactions

Experience with supporting Veterans Health Information Systems and Technology Architecture (VistA) and FileMan applications  
Advanced certifications, including (1) International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB), (2) Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists (CSTE), and/or (3) Certified Software Quality Analyst (CSQA), or similar testing certifications  
Test automation experience  
SQL/database validation experience  
Experience testing cloud-hosted healthcare apps  
Experience with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines  
Experience supporting modernization initiatives involving legacy healthcare systems  
Familiarity with federal healthcare programs and regulations

  

**Formal Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, or related field

  

**Citizenship Requirement**

**U.S. Citizenship required for this specific opportunity**

  

**Security Clearance Requirements**

Must possess or qualify for a Public Trust (MBI)

  

**CRITICAL NOTES:**

* SSG will not make assumptions regarding your qualifications. Your answers to the mandatory screening questions must be supported by the information on your resume. Applications with inconsistencies will not be considered.
* Recruiters or Third parties will not be considered.
* This is a 100% U.S. based remote position. However, candidates from CA, CO, IL, MN, NJ, NY, OR, or WA will not be considered.
* This is a W-2 position
* All interviews will be conducted on Microsoft Teams with your camera on; there will be no exceptions
* As part of our screening process, you will be requested to provide a link to your LinkedIn profile

  
***U.S Citizenship is required for this specific opportunity***. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information and be able to obtain a government-granted security clearance. Individuals may also be subject to a background investigation including, but not limited to criminal history, employment and education verification, drug testing, and creditworthiness.  
  
Syms Strategic Group, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or genetic information.

1e9b8e2d259a3a0de175.title: Affiliate Partnerships Manager
1e9b8e2d259a3a0de175.description:
Siege Media is a growing and remote-first GEO agency! We are nationally recognized on Inc.’s Best Workplaces list and Inc. 5000 list, highlighting the 5000 fastest-growing private companies. Interested in joining the Siege team? We currently have a spot open for a talented full-time Affiliate Partnerships Manager to own client affiliate programs end to end and help turn affiliate partnerships into a growth lever for both traditional search and AI-driven discovery.

Perks for U.S. employees include 100% health, dental, and vision benefits, 50% 401(k) match up to 6% of your salary, donation matching, career development training, unlimited PTO plus encouraged mental health days, paid parental leave, and remote work equipment. We hold team-wide health challenges and virtual events to make remote work genuinely fun.

Learn more about working at Siege by experiencing our culture on Instagram and checking out our work on Dribbble!

Siege Media values diversity. We encourage people of color, LGBTQIA+ folks, veterans, parents and those with disabilities to apply. We are committed to helping all people succeed at Siege. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete our application or interview process, please let us know.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the strategy, execution, and day-to-day management of affiliate programs across a portfolio of client accounts, serving as the primary point of contact for affiliate work.
* Build program strategies and 30/60/90-day roadmaps that tie affiliate partnerships to client revenue, visibility, and LLM/AI discovery goals.
* Lead partner recruitment, negotiation, and activation across publishers, review sites, newsletters, creators, and marketplaces, including commission structures, rev share terms, flat fees, and insertion orders.
* Run Siege’s affiliate playbooks for recruitment, onboarding, content partnerships, and performance management, and recommend improvements to the Director of Affiliate Partnerships as you learn what works.
* Set up and QA tracking, attribution, and reporting workflows on platforms such as Impact, PartnerStack, CJ, and Awin.
* Analyze program performance, diagnose issues (e.g., high-click/low-conversion partners), and make optimization decisions without needing step-by-step direction.
* Lead client meetings and present performance results, insights, and recommendations confidently and independently.
* Train, mentor, and review the work of Affiliate Partnerships Specialists, delegating tasks and providing clear feedback.
* Support the Director on sales calls and proposals by helping scope engagements, estimate opportunity, and outline partner strategies.
* Collaborate with SEO, content, and digital PR teams to build integrated growth strategies for clients.
* Help grow Siege Media’s agency partnership and referral program.
* Hit project deadlines and utilization goals while managing priorities across multiple accounts.
* Stay current on affiliate industry trends, platforms, and how AI and LLMs are changing discovery and partner value.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* 4–6 years of experience in affiliate marketing, partnership marketing, influencer marketing, or performance marketing, with at least 2 years owning programs or client accounts directly.
* 2+ years of experience in an agency or services environment.
* Proven track record of recruiting, negotiating with, and growing affiliate partners that drove measurable revenue.
* Deep working knowledge of affiliate tracking and attribution, including cookies, pixels, postback/server-to-server tracking, attribution windows, commission models, and insertion orders.
* Hands-on experience with affiliate platforms such as Impact, PartnerStack, CJ, Awin, Amazon Associates, Everflow, or similar networks, including program setup and troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn campaign data into clear recommendations and forecasts.
* Solid understanding of digital marketing funnels, conversion metrics, and how affiliate partnerships support broader business goals.
* Confident client communicator who can lead meetings, present results, and manage expectations without senior support.
* Experience guiding, training, or reviewing the work of junior team members.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines in a fully remote environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working in Google Workspace and project management systems.
* Strong interest in how AI and LLMs are changing discovery, distribution, and the value of affiliate partners.

**Suggested Skills**
--------------------

* Experience with both B2B (e.g., SaaS) and B2C affiliate programs.
* Experience with creator and influencer partnerships alongside editorial and publisher partners.
* Experience supporting sales calls, proposals, or scoping new engagements.
* Experience contributing to or building playbooks, SOPs, or reporting frameworks.
* PXA Industry Associate Certification or comparable affiliate marketing certification.

**Salary Range**
----------------

The salary range for this position is 86,000–95,000 annually, depending on experience, affiliate marketing expertise, partner recruitment and negotiation experience, platform knowledge, client-facing experience, team leadership, and agency background.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Managers of Affiliate Partnerships are the owners of Siege’s client affiliate programs. Reporting to the Director of Affiliate Partnerships, they turn the Director’s playbooks and service vision into results on real accounts, while guiding Specialists who support day-to-day execution.

Successful Managers act as trusted advisors to clients. They set a clear program strategy, recruit and activate the right partners, and use data to decide where to invest, renegotiate, or move on. They know how affiliate partnerships contribute to revenue, organic visibility, and AI-driven discovery, and they can explain that value clearly to clients who are new to the channel.

In this role, success means growing affiliate-driven revenue and partner quality across your accounts, keeping clients informed and confident, delivering accurate reporting, and helping Specialists do their best work. Managers spot patterns across accounts and feed what they learn back into Siege’s playbooks.

As they grow in the role, Managers take on larger and more complex accounts, a bigger part in sales and scoping, and more people leadership, positioning them for senior leadership within the affiliate practice.

**Application Materials**
-------------------------

Please plan to upload the following during the application process:

* Your resume
* A short introduction/cover letter
* Case Study/Question: Describe an affiliate program you owned and grew. What was your strategy, how did you decide which partners to invest in, and what results did it drive?

Compensation Range: $86K - $95K

f97831b7fffb6b33b057.title: Regulatory Licensing & Enrollment Specialist
f97831b7fffb6b33b057.description:
**About Renew Health + Recovery:**

Renew Health + Recovery provides in-home and virtual substance use disorder treatment, bringing personalized care directly to clients where they live. Our model is designed to support lasting recovery by helping clients build healthier lives while staying connected to their families, communities, and everyday routines. We currently serve clients across 11 states, with a team committed to making high-quality treatment more accessible. We offer a holistic approach to treatment and change the way clients receive care throughout the country. Our program is a year-long, home based, addiction treatment program that works collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team to assist clients in their first year of recovery.

The Regulatory Licensing & Enrollment Specialist supports Renew Health & Recovery's multi-state regulatory licensing, accreditation, and payer enrollment activities, with a primary focus on facilitating organizational growth and expansion into new markets.

This position coordinates new state licensing applications, regulatory approvals, and ongoing licensure requirements while supporting The Joint Commission (TJC) accreditation activities and organizational compliance initiatives. The Specialist also assists with Medicare and Medicaid enrollment, facility credentialing, and commercial payer enrollment processes as needed to support operational readiness and continuity of services.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable researching regulatory requirements, coordinating complex applications, communicating with regulatory agencies, and managing multiple projects in a growing healthcare organization.

**Salary Range:** $55,000–$60,000 annually

**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Regulatory Licensing & Expansion**

* Research and analyze state-specific licensing, certification, and regulatory requirements to support expansion into new markets.
* Coordinate and prepare initial licensing applications for new states, programs, services, and organizational entities.
* Support regulatory activities related to organizational growth, expansion into new states, and new program and service development.
* Serve as a primary point of contact with assigned state licensing and regulatory agencies.
* Manage assigned license renewals, amendments, regulatory updates, and required notifications.
* Maintain licensing trackers, application timelines, regulatory correspondence, and supporting documentation.
* Monitor changes in applicable state and federal regulations and communicate relevant updates and potential impacts to leadership.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to obtain required documentation and support timely regulatory submissions.
* Evaluate application requirements, identify potential regulatory barriers, and recommend solutions or escalation to leadership.

**Accreditation & Survey Readiness**

* Support ongoing compliance with The Joint Commission accreditation standards and requirements.
* Assist with accreditation applications, renewals, and organizational updates.
* Coordinate documentation and preparation activities for licensing and accreditation surveys.
* Participate in mock surveys, tracers, and regulatory readiness assessments as assigned.
* Develop and maintain accreditation checklists, monitoring tools, and regulatory tracking resources.
* Assist with corrective action plans and required follow-up submissions.
* Collaborate with operational leadership to support continuous survey readiness.
* Provide guidance and education to internal stakeholders regarding applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements.

**Payer Credentialing & Enrollment Support**

* Assist with organizational and facility credentialing and enrollment with commercial payers, Medicare, and Medicaid as needed.
* Support payer credentialing applications, renewals, recredentialing, and demographic updates.
* Coordinate collection and submission of organizational, licensing, accreditation, and provider documentation required for payer participation.
* Assist with Medicare and Medicaid enrollment applications and related updates when assigned.
* Support payer enrollment activities associated with new states, organizational entities, and program expansion.
* Maintain credentialing and enrollment trackers, monitor application status, and follow up on outstanding requirements.
* Communicate with payer representatives and enrollment agencies to facilitate application processing.
* Collaborate with internal departments to support timely enrollment and network participation.

**Compliance & Organizational Support**

* Support regulatory compliance initiatives, internal monitoring activities, and organizational improvement projects.
* Assist with regulatory research and review of organizational policies and procedures.
* Develop and maintain standardized regulatory checklists, reporting tools, and compliance documentation.
* Support internal audits, compliance reviews, and corrective action follow-up as assigned.
* Collaborate with Human Resources, Learning & Development, and operational leadership to support regulatory education and readiness.
* Prepare status reports and updates related to licensing, accreditation, and enrollment activities.
* Participate in organizational committees, workgroups, and special projects as assigned.
* Monitor and respond to assigned Compliance department communications.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Minimum of three years of experience in healthcare regulatory licensing, accreditation, compliance, or a related healthcare administrative function.
* Experience coordinating regulatory applications, renewals, or licensing documentation.
* Familiarity with healthcare regulatory requirements and accreditation processes.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to independently manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.
* Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret regulatory requirements and technical documentation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate professionally with regulatory agencies, payers, and internal stakeholders.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Ability to develop and maintain accurate tracking systems, records, and reports.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to identify and escalate issues appropriately.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment and collaborate effectively across departments.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound professional judgment.

**Preferred**

* Experience in behavioral health, substance use disorder treatment, or other regulated healthcare settings.
* Experience with multi-state healthcare licensing and organizational expansion.
* Knowledge of The Joint Commission Behavioral Health Care accreditation standards.
* Experience with Medicare and Medicaid provider enrollment, including organizational or facility enrollment.
* Experience with commercial payer credentialing and enrollment processes.
* Familiarity with PECOS, NPPES, CAQH, state Medicaid enrollment portals, and payer credentialing systems.
* Experience supporting multi-state healthcare expansion, new entity licensing, and new program launches.
* Knowledge of healthcare compliance requirements, including HIPAA and applicable state and federal regulations.
* Experience with regulatory monitoring, policy and procedure review, and survey preparation.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Organization and attention to detail
* Initiative and accountability
* Regulatory research and analytical thinking
* Project coordination and time management
* Professional communication
* Collaboration and teamwork
* Adaptability and problem-solving
* Integrity and confidentiality
* Commitment to regulatory compliance and quality improvement

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

This position is an individual contributor role without direct supervisory responsibilities. The Specialist is expected to independently coordinate assigned regulatory licensing and enrollment activities while working under the direction of the VP of Regulatory Compliance & Quality. Final regulatory determinations, payer contract negotiations, and enterprise compliance oversight remain with designated leadership.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Responsibilities may evolve based on organizational needs.

**Benefits Highlights:**

**Coverage:** Health, vision and dental through Cigna, FSA, HSA that comes with an employer match, along with STD, LTD, life insurance, EAP, and more.  
**Balance:** Competitive accrued Paid Time Off (PTO) plan, 10 paid Holidays, 2 paid floating Holidays of your choice, and 7 days of Sick Time.  
**Development:** Certification/continuing education eligibility, leadership development and 1 paid day off a year to go towards personal professional development.  
Retirement: 401(k) retirement plan with Voya.  
**Culture:** Dedication to diversity, equity and inclusion, and a growing working environment.  
\*In order to be eligible for our full benefits package you must be employed full time at a minimum of 32 hours a week\*

**EEO Statement:**  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

**About the Role**

As part of the Siemens Value Advisory Services Team, the Informatics Analyst plays a critical role in supporting operational‑improvement initiatives across leading health systems. This position requires a professional who can evaluate processes, requirements, and results across assigned workflows and contribute meaningfully to both team and customer outcomes. You will apply experienced analytical capabilities and intermediate‑to‑proficient technical skills to solve healthcare data challenges that vary in size, complexity, and context—while continuously expanding your technical knowledge and domain expertise.

In this role, you will analyze healthcare data and operational workflows, support the design and maintenance of Snowflake data structures, optimize data for visualization in Qlik, and collaborate closely with consultants, customers, and technical teams to deliver high‑quality analytics solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze healthcare data and customer workflows, considering related processes and results to support effective team solutions.
* Support the design and maintenance of database structures in Snowflake, including data models, integration processes, performance, data quality, and maintainability.
* Transform and optimize data for efficient visualization and analysis in Qlik, following established performance, usability, governance, and business requirements.
* Develop and enhance analytics tools, reusable data assets, visualizations, and KPIs in collaboration with clinical consultants, customers, and technical resources.
* Apply intermediate‑to‑proficient skills in at least one technical discipline—such as business intelligence, SQL, data engineering, or data science—to resolve assigned issues that may differ in size and nature.
* Use analytical skills and sound judgment to investigate data issues, identify practical solutions, and contribute to improvements in existing processes and approaches.
* Partner with customers and project team members to define and acquire required data, including data sourced from Epic and other electronic health record systems.
* Manage assigned datasets and databases across customer projects, supporting data quality, traceability, security, and reliable delivery.
* Document solutions, share technical knowledge, participate in peer reviews, and collaborate with team members to achieve project goals.
* Monitor assigned work, communicate progress and risks, and contribute to measurable team and customer results.
* Work closely with local and global Siemens teams, including direct interaction with clients and support for pre‑sales activities as needed.

**Capabilities That Will Help You Succeed**

* Business intelligence expertise, especially with Qlik, including data modeling, scripting, dashboard design, and performance optimization.
* Strong SQL proficiency applied to organizing data, supporting scalable data architecture, and optimizing reporting workflows.
* Data architecture awareness and understanding of how data structures influence reporting quality and operational insights.
* Reporting optimization skills that ensure dashboards and analytics solutions are accurate, performant, and aligned with consulting needs.
* Technical communication skills to explain analytical concepts to clinical, operational, and executive audiences.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with consultants and contribute to team outcomes in fast‑moving project environments.
* Commitment to continuous learning and expanding technical capabilities in a rapidly evolving healthcare informatics landscape.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, computer science, health informatics, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in data analytics, database management, data engineering, or business intelligence in a Healthcare arena required
* Intermediate‑to‑advanced skills in at least one technical discipline such as BI development, SQL, data engineering, or data science.
* Strong SQL capability applied to data organization, architecture, and reporting optimization.
* Hands‑on experience developing or supporting BI solutions, preferably with Qlik.
* Experience with cloud‑based data platforms; Snowflake experience preferred.
* Experience with data cleaning, transformation, integration, quality assurance, and technical documentation.
* Ability to communicate analytical findings to non‑technical audiences.
* Willingness to travel up to 10%.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced coursework or a degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Computer Science, or Health Informatics.
* Experience working in a healthcare provider, healthcare technology, or healthcare consulting environment.
* Familiarity with Epic data structures, reporting tools, and clinical or operational workflows.
* Hands‑on Snowflake experience in data modeling, development, or performance optimization.
* Qlik development experience, including scripting, modeling, dashboard design, and tuning.
* Certifications in Snowflake, Qlik, Epic, or related analytics/healthcare technology domains.

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work:** When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Siemens Healthineers businesses, please visit our company page here.

23ea787e9ac6a8efd6b1.description:
**Have you ever enjoyed Arnold®, Brownberry® or Oroweat® bread? A Thomas’® English muffin or bagel? Or perhaps snacked on a Sara Lee®, Entenmann’s® or Marinela® cake or donut? If the answer is yes, then you know Bimbo Bakeries USA!****#LI-JV1**

***More than 20,000 associates in bakeries, sales centers, offices and on sales routes work to ensure our consumers have the freshest products at every meal. In addition to competitive pay and benefits, we provide a safe and inclusive work environment that appreciates diversity, promotes development and allows our associates to be their authentic selves.***

**Come join the largest baking company in the world and our family of 20,000 associates nationwide!**

**Top Reasons to Work at Bimbo Bakeries USA:**

**Salary Range: $101,000 - $ 131,300**

**Annual Bonus Eligibility**

**Comprehensive Benefits Package**

**Paid Time Off**

**401k & Company Match**

#LI-PS1

**Position Summary:**

The Specialist Order Forecasting will support the Bimbo Bakeries USA business by defining and executing to bring world-class technology solutions to nationwide sales professional leaders and enable product sales growth and market execution excellence. This position will work with internal and partner vendor technology and development teams to prototype, test, evaluate and create or customize hardware and software solutions. The Specialist Order Forecasting will be charged with understanding the customer needs and workflow, prioritizing functionality, evaluating vendors, writing epics and user stories to deliver solutions in an Agile process. This role will also work with operational and other sales teams to test and deploy these solutions across the entire sales team, collecting and prioritizing feedback and issues for resolution. The Specialist Order Forecasting will become the DSD Excellence team’s “voice of the customer” for the market sales leader for any hardware and software solutions they use. The position will also provide technical support for sales technology and applications; both to assist end users as well as participating in field tests of new releases and solutions to ensure effective in-market capabilities.

**Key Job Responsibilities:**

* Focus in a specific regional area, on individual customers and stores to validate and adapt customer promotion, new product launch, store opening / closing, holiday and other special circumstance or specific weekly plans and translate that into volume modifications and exception information for frontline ordering.
* Coordinates on major initiatives with national and regional customer teams, corporate brand teams, regional or local sales teams, manufacturing and supply chain teams to understand key initiatives in terms of scope, priority, and expected outcome. Ensure data governance of upstream systems that input to the order forecasting system to generate appropriate suggested frontline customer order volumes. Leads recurring coordination meetings.
* Manage potential discrepancies between the customer and brand planning teams or sales leadership to set expectations based on forecasting outcomes guided by data and experience.
* Assist the frontline by modifying specific suggested order volume or communicating the need for frontline focus in areas based on data analysis of events and suggested volume orders for events and weekly ordering.
* Assist the frontline, local sales teams, operational supply chain efforts to achieve increased growth and freshness through coaching of proper ordering disciplines.
* Analysis of promotional ordering and sales results to determine effectiveness of previous strategy and volume and outline potential areas and causes of differences between plan and actual sales.
* Responsibilities include collaboration with other stakeholders and collecting data from multiple sources ensuring the accurate collection and entry of information to produce accurate forecasts as well as to measure execution. Guide the development team as needed with inputs on data entity expansion.
* Provides inputs to DSDE Technology team members, technical staff as needed to identify, outline, and collaborate on potential enhancements, corrections and adjustments of forecasting algorithm and system software or communication technologies to better achieve growth, freshness and route operations. Providing insight and analysis on potential technology solutions proposed by the development and product teams as well as collaboration on new concepts.
* Perform system maintenance as needed to ensure accurate representation and operation of route configurations, store, product and visit scheduling and product alignment and data.
* Ensures growth and optimization of frontline awareness, market share and/or specified initiatives as well as providing market execution information to supply, brand and account teams.
* Develops effective working relationships with stakeholders including local sales leadership to achieve targeted goals and/or solutions.
* Interacts with peers in management / customers / vendors to interpret information and improve cross-functional processes and programs.
* Travel is required < 10 %.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Key Behavioral Competencies:**

* Must have the ability and experience to act as “influencer” to frontline, sales leadership and upstream data, with and independent from sales, marketing, customer or supply chain team partners.
* Demonstrated mastery of data analysis tools and approaches for forecast accuracy and execution measurement.
* Ability to calculate product volumes and analyze variances as they occur to determine suggested course of action in communication, volume modification, or input correction.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and can interact at all levels of the organization.
* Candidate must have analytic problem-solving skills and be able to dig beyond the surface for deeper-level insights to drive actionable adjustments.
* Candidate must display good interpersonal skills, including a positive "team-player" attitude - within the department and outside.

**Education and Work History:**

Bachelor’s level degree preferred in Business, Statistical or Mathematical function or Communications. A combination of education, training and experience that results in demonstrated competency to perform the work may be substituted.

Ideal candidate will possess:

* 5 – 7 years of experience in business analysis, sales planning, DSD route management, finance or statistical modeling.
* Computer skills and proficiency, specifically PowerPoint, Excel, and Word is required, as well as proficiency with PROMPT and Margin Minder or other data analysis and dashboarding tools.

**Physical Demands:**

The physical and mental demands described in each job posting are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of each job. Reasonable accommodations may be requested to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of each job.

Bimbo Bakeries USA is an equal opportunity employer with a policy that provides equal employment opportunity for applicants and employees regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, any other classification protected by law.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

c2bba63e53d744faac43.title: R&D Test Engineer
c2bba63e53d744faac43.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Agilent is seeking an experienced and motivated Advanced Test Engineer to join the Software Quality Engineering organization within the Services Division of the Agilent CrossLab Group (ACG).  
  
The Advanced Test Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality software solutions across the Services software portfolio. This role partners closely with Product Management, Software Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Customer Support teams to define test strategies, implement automated quality solutions, and drive quality throughout the software development lifecycle.  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong testing expertise, technical depth, business understanding, and Agile delivery experience to identify quality risks, improve engineering practices, and ensure reliable software releases. The role is expected to leverage modern test automation, AI-assisted testing techniques, and continuous quality engineering principles to improve product quality and delivery efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own quality planning, test strategy, and validation activities for one or more software products.
* Participate as an active member of Agile product teams, collaborating with Product Owners, developers, architects, and DevOps engineers.
* Define and execute risk-based testing strategies focused on business-critical functionality and quality risks.
* Develop and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, API, and automated testing.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions that support CI/CD pipelines.
* Perform backend and data validation testing, including database verification and system integration validation.
* Review requirements and designs to ensure testability, quality, and customer value.
* Identify quality risks early and drive preventative quality engineering practices.
* Perform root cause analysis and partner with engineering teams to improve product quality and reliability.
* Contribute to test environment management, test data strategy, release readiness assessments, and defect governance.
* Drive continuous improvement of testing approaches, frameworks, and engineering processes.
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across quality initiatives.
* Support compliance, cybersecurity, and regulatory validation activities where applicable.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical discipline.
* 4+ years of software testing, quality engineering, or software development experience. 5 years of experience is helpful.
* Experience working within Agile software development environments.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing comprehensive test strategies and test plans.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies including functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Experience with test automation frameworks and automated testing practices.
* Experience validating web applications, APIs, microservices, and enterprise software systems.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause investigation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while influencing cross-functional teams and technical decisions.
* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated testing solutions.
* Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting automated tests within CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar platforms.

**Preferred:**

  

* Experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman, REST API testing, or similar automation technologies.
* Experience testing cloud-native or SaaS applications.
* Experience with AI-assisted testing tools, test generation, or intelligent quality engineering approaches.
* Experience in laboratory informatics, compliance software, scientific software, or regulated environments.
* Experience with performance, security, and reliability testing.
* Experience mentoring other engineers or leading quality initiatives across multiple teams.

**Additional Details**

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. ad098bd3a0a79ac24155.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Engineering Manager

\_\_

**Your role and responsibilities**

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions.

The Quality Engineer will serve as both a technical design authority and a customer-facing lead for ABB Critical Power projects. This role combines engineering responsibilities with commercial customer engagement to ensure successful project delivery and resolution of customer quality issues. Utilizing management skills, technical under standing of products, and communication skills to lead the ABB service, engineering, factory, and product management to solve and resolve customer quality issues.

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.  
  
The work model for the role is: Remote {#LI-Remote}

40% travel requirement for customer visits and project support.
  
  
**Your role and responsibilities:**

* Serve as ABB’s primary customer contact for quality and technical issues, leading communications, onsite support, action plans, and resolution timelines.
* Act as the technical and design authority for engineering deliverables on moderate- to high-complexity projects.
* Review and approve designs, perform verification and peer reviews, and ensure compliance with safety, quality, contractual, and as-built documentation requirements.
* Identify and resolve technical challenges while communicating product gaps, customer needs, and market trends to commercial and product management teams.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, manufacturing, testing, commissioning, service, supply chain, sales, and product management to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects, including work plans, cost estimates, RFQs, supplier evaluations, project meetings, contract variations, and timely delivery of engineering outputs.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or (related field) with 7+ years’ experience in electrical distribution or power systems; Master’s degree with 5+ years’ experience in electrical distribution or power systems.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills; fluent in English (written and spoken).
* Proficiency in MS Office, MS Teams, and ability to leverage AI tools in job functions.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and work independently with minimal supervision.
* Capability to establish and nurture partnership relationships with ABB Product management, engineering, and service.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* PE Certification
* Experience with LV/MV UPS systems, batteries, static transfer switches, power conditioning, PDUs, and ATS.
* Familiarity with industry codes and standards (ANSI, IEEE, NEC, NEMA, NFPA 70E, UL).
* Lean Six Sigma Certification
* Previous field, factory, or design engineering experience in data centers, hospitals, or industrial facilities.

**What's in it for you**

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.
