6626adf48e0fe9fa19c9.title: Campus Operations & Security Manager
6626adf48e0fe9fa19c9.description:
**CAMPUS OPERATIONS & SECURITY MANAGER**

SUMMARY: The Campus Operations & Security Manager provides leadership and operational oversight of facility management, environmental services, physical security, and emergency preparedness across Esperanza Healthcare Center facilities. The position serves a dual role of ensuring safe, well-maintained, and welcoming environments for patients, staff, and visitors while meeting the maintenance and development needs of the organization. This position supervises custodial and security functions and may provide direct frontline operational support when necessary to maintain service continuity.

**Compensation**
----------------

**$54,000 – $70,000 annually | Midpoint $62,000**

Placement within the range is based on relevant experience, qualifications, demonstrated competencies, and internal equity.

Esperanza Health Center offers a comprehensive benefits package to eligible full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; retirement contributions; and other benefits designed to support employee well-being and professional growth.

**Facilities Management**

Serve as the primary steward of Esperanza's three facilities, overseeing all interior and exterior cleaning, maintenance, and capital improvement activities needed to sustain safe, pleasant, and welcoming environments for patients, staff, and the public.

Lead and direct the custodial supervisor and staff in scheduled daily and periodic cleaning activities; oversee the identification and scheduling of planned maintenance and expedite repairs as needed.

Ensure compliance with all state and local codes for facility and environmental safety, including maintaining appropriate licenses and certifications.

Monitor and manage maintenance contracts for equipment and environmental services; participate in the identification and selection of vendors and partners as appropriate.

Annually develop and manage the facilities budget in partnership with the Associate Operations Director; develop and manage annual and long-range (three-year) capital budgets.

Support operational logistics including room setup, furniture movement, and special facilities projects.

Develops and maintains tracking systems for the inspection, maintenance, and upkeep of facility infrastructure and equipment, including elevators, HVAC systems, plumbing, electrical systems, fire suppression and sprinkler systems, emergency lighting, generators, roofing, and building access control systems.

**Campus Operations & Environmental Services**

Oversee public access points and common areas across all facilities to ensure safe, organized, and mission-aligned environments.

Ensure assigned staff provide appropriate greeting, assistance, and workflow support throughout the campus.

Coordinate shipping and receiving processes and ensure adherence to established procedures.

Ensure Shared Spaces and common areas remain clean, organized, and safe through coordination with custodial and facilities staff.

Support coordination of patient flow and visitor access across facilities in collaboration with clinical and operations leadership.

Monitor activity across buildings, entrances, parking areas, and common spaces and ensure timely response to issues in accordance with established protocols.

Provide direct frontline coverage for environmental services, monitoring, or security functions when staffing shortages or operational needs require.

**Safety & Security Management**

Oversee physical security operations to safeguard buildings, grounds, assets, employees, patients, and visitors.

Ensure appropriate security staffing, systems, fire and life safety measures, and response protocols are in place to mitigate risks including accidents, fires, and natural disasters.

Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate security personnel in accordance with organizational policies and procedures.

Coordinate access control, surveillance systems, and alarm monitoring.

Monitor security logs, investigate incidents, and prepare reports with corrective action recommendations.

Liaise with local police and partner organizations as needed.

Ensure staff awareness of security responsibilities through training and communication initiatives.

Participate in an environment of care and safety rounds.

Support the development and maintenance of Emergency Operations Plans for each facility in accordance with regional and national best practices.

Conduct and log periodic emergency drills and tabletop exercises; incorporate lessons learned into updated plans.

**Policy & Procedure Development**

Develop, implement, and maintain organizational policies, protocols, and standard operating procedures related to facilities management, environmental services, safety, and security.

Ensure policies remain compliant with regulatory requirements and reflect operational best practices.

Conduct periodic review and revision of policies and procedures and coordinate staff training on updates.

**Competencies**

* Self-directed and motivated
* Facilities or operations management experience in a supervisory capacity
* Experience developing and implementing policies and procedures
* Excellent leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Proficient in conflict resolution techniques
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with people of diverse ages, backgrounds, and life experiences
* Independent thinker and effective problem-solver
* Ability to integrate faith into work-related tasks

**Knowledge, Skills, and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Facilities Management, Operations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience; security experience or security management experience preferred.
* Proven experience in facilities or operations management, with customer service responsibility
* Familiarity with building systems, maintenance operations, and vendor management
* Familiarity with closed-circuit television, alarm systems, and building access control systems
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), internet browsers, and email clients
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for both individual and group audiences Working Conditions
* Ability to spend 75% of work time on their feet
* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds
* Ability to drive a company vehicle
* Weekend and evening hours variability can be expected

95699c7e3d438747f843.title: Temporary Coordinator - Distribution Services
95699c7e3d438747f843.description:
The Team:

The Distribution Services and Traffic team is responsible for coordinating the movement of orders within the organization, ensuring efficient processes and timely delivery. This includes adapting to changes, optimizing workflows, and providing exceptional customer service. Overall, our goal is to support business growth and create a productive environment by ensuring seamless operations and meeting customer commitments. Our Distribution Services and Traffic team works closely with boutiques to organize their priorities on a daily basis. By effectively managing the flow of products and aligning with boutique needs, we aim to ensure that their orders are processed efficiently and delivered on time. This collaborative approach allows us to meet customer commitments and support overall business growth.

Position Overview:

In your role as a Coordinator, Distribution Service, you are responsible for providing exceptional customer service to both internal and external clients, while demonstrating exemplary compliance with HOP’s corporate culture, company policies and operational procedures.

Your primary focus will be to provide order statuses for all client purchases from order inception to the actual receipt of goods at the final delivery destination. The Distribution Service Associate needs to clearly communicate with their assigned clients, as well as anticipate and fully understand the client’s needs and expectations. Responses and updates to clients and key internal HOP stakeholders would be conveyed through the utilization of Outlook emails, Microsoft TEAMS messaging, phone calls, or updates within HOP proprietary software applications.

The Coordinator, Distribution Service will be assigned to assist and support one HOP division, however in your role you will be cross trained to assist other HOP divisions as well as fellow Distribution Service Associates when necessary to ensure continuity of service. You will act as a liaison and key point of contact between Dayton’s customers and the distribution center team by effectively communicating the necessary client requests and requirements. Any errors, shortfalls in communications or processes based upon the required departmental protocols should be immediately shared with either your immediate manager or the departmental manager .

This role handles all company assets, product and material with care and respect to the Hermes brand and is responsible for the daily assigned duties to support HOP’s internet sales initiatives and related customer care requirements. All work must be neat, accurate and within procedural guidelines.

The Opportunity:

Logistics Services

* Process incoming order requests from internal and external clients
* Actively offer clients alternative item selections in the event their original item requests are not available or currently out of stock by recommending an appropriate item substitution or add-on
* Process stock orders from vendors as requested by the sales divisions and ensure that all purchase orders are confirmed with an estimated delivery ETA (estimated time of arrival) to achieve a prompt delivery
* Review the daily back-order report to effectively anticipate and communicate the status of client order requests as well as possible delivery delays
* Negotiate order extensions by properly monitoring order start ship and cancel dates, which once confirmed, will require further shipping details and coordination with the Dayton distribution center for a smooth and timely client delivery experience
* Effectively review and correct client order confirmations utilizing EDI software by resolving item number discrepancies, unit mismatches, as well as issues with item style, color, pricing, and purchase quantity issues, thus ensuring order adjustments are found & corrected prior to shipment and effectively communicated to each account
* Responsible for issuing Return Authorizations (RA’s) as requested and approved by the appropriate sales division

Administrative Tasks & Reporting

* Prepares Loans and ITS documents for the Dayton warehouse to process as needed
* Perform the daily creation, generation, and review of the following department reports: Merchandise On-Hand, Summary of Open Pick Tickets, Back Order Merchandise, and Open BP Receipts.
* Assist Dayton Management Team upon request with the status of pending inbound Hermes merchandise shipments (BP’s) from HOP France to determine the proper prioritization and processing time required for each once received at the Dayton NJ distribution center
* Perform the weekly processing of Cegid replenishment requests

Vendor Compliance

* Knowledge of and willingness to learn all applicable vendor routing guidelines
* Summarize and inform the Dayton shipping department and fellow CSA Team members of any changes or updates to vendor routing guidelines
* Assists with the investigation and provides the necessary back-up documentation for the timely resolution and reversal of vendor chargebacks.

Additional Requirements

* As a back-up to your immediate manager, serve as the secondary customer service contact to address and prioritize urgent needs with the distribution center management team to satisfy internal and external stakeholder requests
* In cooperation with your immediate or departmental manager, proactively communicate and support the HOP retail boutiques to better understand their inbound merchandise shipment requirements to accommodate their space constraints as well as each location’s processing limitations for the receipt of goods in the store’s back of house storage
* Assist HOP Management by communicating inventory store cutoffs or shipment holds due to physical inventories at the boutiques or in the event of space constraints due to excess inventory on hand at the requesting store locations
* As instructed by your manager, support the Inventory Control Management Team with item inventory discrepancies to facilitate the appropriate reconciliation process, thus ensuring a minimal level of inventory shrinkage

**Software Applications**

SCALE WMS, Cegid, Microsoft Office Suite & TEAMS, EDI, HCare, Infocenter

Supervisory Responsibility:

NO  



Budget Responsibility:

NO  



Decision Making Responsibility:

NO  



About You:

* 1-2 years of experience, including either a hands-on internship or activities in a similar role and/or department
* Minimum educational requirements of a High School Diploma (BS or BA Degree preferred but not required)
* Excellent attention to detail & strong organizational skills
* An active and continuous learner
* Demonstrates a willingness to work with HOP team members in various departments throughout HOP’s varied and growing organization
* Ability to work independently with little supervision
* Proven track record of meeting both short & long-term goals and deadlines
* Displays appropriate level of urgency when addressing and resolving client escalations and actionable customer service requests
* Intermediate to Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel software
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* This position requires a flexible schedule to meet the needs of the business, including extended holiday hours during designated periods throughout the year
All other duties as assigned by their immediate manager or departmental director  

The range for this position is $25.00 per hour. Actual rates are determined based on the job, location, and individual experience.

We are looking for a candidate that has a combination of the above attributes and can perform the key functions of the role with or without reasonable accommodations.

**Company Overview:**

Since 1837, Hermès has remained faithful to its artisan business model and humanist values. We place people at the heart of what we do and aspire to make a positive impact on the world. The freedom to create, the constant search for beautiful materials, the transmission of a savoir-faire of excellence and the aesthetic of functionality define the singularity of Hermès, a house dedicated to making highly-crafted, beautiful objects made to stand the test of time.

An independent, family-owned company, Hermès is dedicated to keeping production in France through its 42 workshops, The Hermès organization is also a truly global community with a network of 310 stores in 49 countries. Hermès employs more than 15,000 people worldwide with over 6,000 of the workforce being Hermès craftspeople engaged in making artisanal products, nurturing a 180+ year tradition of creativity and innovation.

At Hermès, our actions for sustainable development and corporate social responsibility are founded in values passed down by generations of humble artisans who have shaped the story of our house and the integrity of our objects. The roots of Hermès’ success and longevity lie in a sense of responsibility; a quest for authenticity and respect for time and preservation of natural resources. All at Hermès wish to leave a positive footprint on the world, a mission that’s at the heart of our commitment to progress. This narrative can be experienced in a series of shorts films “Footsteps Across the World” available on our website. Link here .

**Our Commitment:**

At Hermès of Paris we look to create a diverse workforce of talented and unique individuals with different backgrounds, skillsets and worldviews that will enrich our Hermès of Paris family. We support our individual team members personal and professional success through a culture that values equality, individuality and fairness and through an environment where individuals can thrive and feel comfortable being their authentic selves. Beyond the walls of our Maison, we advance our DIF values through the work that we do in partnership with our community and non-profit partners.

At Hermès of Paris, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. It is the policy of Hermès of Paris, Inc. that applicants for employment are recruited, selected and hired on the basis of individual merit and ability with respect to positions being filled and potential for promotion or transfer which may be expected to develop. Applicants are recruited, selected and hired without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, military or veteran status or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. In addition, personnel procedures and practices with regard to training, promotion, transfer, compensation, demotion, lay off or termination are to be administered with due regard to job performance, experience and qualifications, but without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, military or veteran status or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Hermès of Paris, Inc. also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, in accordance with applicable laws.

For additional details or if you have questions, contact us at privacy.us@hermes.com. Please do not submit resumes or applications to this email address.

4f9a31edb2818e09b636.description:
As a Population Health Strategy & Operations Senior Manager, you will focus on the operational effectiveness of our Population Health programs. The ideal candidate balances long-term strategic thinking with deep operational expertise and is motivated by execution. Think of this role as the key operating partner for our Population Health businesses - you will lead team meetings, drive focus around key priorities, track daily and weekly metrics of business performance, and drop in deep across the team on key initiatives. You will turn messy, cross-functional work into actionable plans, leverage AI to drive team efficiency (including, and especially, ours!), and conduct deep-dive operational assessments to identify and implement efficiency drivers. This role is an individual contributor reporting to the Senior Director, Population Health Strategy & Operations.

### **Responsibilities:**

* **Lead Operational Testing & Experiments:** Drive ops testing for Care & Case Management (CCM) and navigation teams, including things like AI calling pilots, abbreviated intake pilots, and deep assessments to improve operational value
* **Manage Cross-Functional Projects:** Turn cross-functional work into owned, executed plans. Drive audit, transition, and staffing workstreams. Manage project timelines, milestones, and KPIs
* **Data-Driven Reporting:** Own daily and weekly business readouts for the CCM business and ensure metrics and reporting remain accurate and honest. Work closely with our data team to ensure the right visibility into the metrics we need, and finding the correct leading indicators as needed for operational changes
* **Leadership Support:** Lead daily huddles for the CCM leadership team and act as a connection point between clinical services
* **Operational Deep Dives:** Conduct deep dives into team operations—including shadowing our navigation, and CCM teams—to determine where bottlenecks exist and develop tests to resolve these issues. Become the business expert on how those teams operate and where their challenges are
* **Population Health Strategy:** Own the executions of key Population Health margin projects (e.g., by developing strategies for secondary clinician utilization and overall clinical operations improvement)
* **Uplevel Team with AI:** Identify opportunities to make the team more efficient and effective through the use of AI productivity tools and automation
* **Product Partnership:** Be the voice of operations for the Population Health team in meetings with our EPDD partners. Work especially closely with our product partners to develop the right new product features that will work with how our teams need to operate in order to drive outcomes (and margin)
* **Risk Mitigation:** Anticipate program risks and develop mitigation strategies; identify potential risks and assess their impact on projects

### **Required Qualifications:**

* At least seven years of experience in a fast-growing business managing cross-functional projects
* Operationally minded: proven ability to analyze a process, identify logjams, and develop tests to resolve issues
* Strong modeling skills: proficiency in Excel to build robust models
* Proficiency with AI productivity tools to enhance efficiency, streamline workflows, and accelerate deliverables
* Ability to organize, delegate, coordinate, consolidate and prioritize multiple simultaneous tasks in a team environment
* Willingness and ability to provide mentoring, coaching, advice, and assistance to employees in a collaborative learning environment
* Excellent oral and written communications skills
* Excellent interpersonal and problem-solving skills
* Comfort with data analysis (experience with Looker preferred)
* Healthcare experience preferred
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills

### **Physical/Cognitive Requirements:**

* Ability to remain seated in a stationary position for prolonged periods.
* Requires eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity sufficient to operate keyboard, computer and other office-related equipment.
* No heavy lifting is expected, though occasional exertion of about 20 lbs. of force (e.g., lifting a computer / laptop) may be required.
* Ability to interact with leadership, employees, and members in an appropriate manner.
* Occasional travel required

The base salary range for this full-time position is **$147,940 – $198,984 per year** in the United States. This posted range reflects the portion of our internal salary band that is currently funded for new hires in this role across our standard labor markets (**Zones A–C**).

For context, these markets include **Zone A** (e.g., Phoenix AZ, San Antonio TX, Columbus OH, Charlotte NC), **Zone B** (e.g., Chicago IL, Denver CO, San Diego CA, Houston TX), and **Zone C** (e.g., Los Angeles CA, Seattle WA, Washington, D.C., Boston MA). At this time, we are not budgeting for hires in **higher-cost Zone D markets** (e.g., San Francisco Bay Area CA, New York City NY, San Jose CA) for this role. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location, skills, experience, and internal equity. We use structured salary bands and geographic zones based on cost of labor to keep pay fair and consistent.

In addition to receiving a great compensation package, the compensation package may include, depending on the role, the following and more:

* Remote-first culture
* 401(k) savings plan through Fidelity
* Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage through multiple medical plan options (including disability insurance)
* Paid Time Off ("PTO") and Discretionary Time Off (“DTO")
* 12 weeks of 100% Paid Parental leave
* Family Building & Compassionate Leave: Fertility coverage, $25,000 for surrogacy/adoption, and paid leave for failed treatments, adoption or pregnancies.
* Work-From-Home reimbursement to support team collaboration home office work

Your recruiter will share more about the salary range and benefits package for your role during the hiring process.

**About Included Health**

Included Health is a new kind of healthcare company, delivering integrated virtual care and navigation. We’re on a mission to raise the standard of healthcare for everyone. We break down barriers to provide high-quality care for every person in every community — no matter where they are in their health journey or what type of care they need, from acute to chronic, behavioral to physical. We offer our members care guidance, advocacy, and access to personalized virtual and in-person care for everyday and urgent care, primary care, behavioral health, and specialty care. It’s all included. Learn more at**includedhealth.com****.**

1a2eb5a6adbb335bb88e.description:
### **Phlebotomy Operations Manager**

### **Location: Remote**

### **Why Ascend?**

### **Come work for a company that is transforming the industry!**

Ascend Clinical, LLC is one of the highest-volume clinical laboratories in the United States, processing millions of tests each month with advanced tools and technology. For over 30 years, we've set the standard for service and excellence in testing.  
  
What sets Ascend apart is our unique combination of clinical and healthcare water testing as we drive innovation across multiple areas of laboratory science. We're growing rapidly and looking for individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment, embrace new challenges, and want to help shape what's next.

**Job Summary:**  
  
The Phlebotomy Operations Manager is responsible for oversight of laboratory‑provided phlebotomy services delivered in outpatient care settings supported by the laboratory. This role ensures high‑quality specimen collection, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and a positive patient experience. The Phlebotomy Operations Manager leads and supports phlebotomy staff manage day‑to‑day service delivery. This individual collaborates with laboratory leadership and clinical partners to support diagnostic testing services nationally. This position is hands‑on and patient and client focused, with primary accountability for staff performance, service quality, and compliance with laboratory standards across supported locations. This is a remote role with approximately 30% travel.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee daily laboratory‑provided phlebotomy and operational services across client locations
* Ensure safe, accurate specimen collection, labeling, handling, and transport in accordance with laboratory policies and regulatory requirements
* Monitor patient flow, specimen integrity, and service quality
* Adjust staffing assignments and workflows to meet service needs and laboratory expectations
* Perform phlebotomy duties as needed to support continuity of care and service delivery in instances where backup phlebotomy services are necessary
* This individual will play an integral role in supporting phlebotomy operational workflows for all CKD programs and initiatives

**Quality, Compliance and Patient/Client Experience:**

* Ensure phlebotomy services comply with laboratory standards, safety requirements, and applicable regulations governing specimen collection and pre‑analytic processes
* Monitor quality indicators, audit findings, incident reports, and patient feedback related to phlebotomy services
* Investigate service issues or complaints and implement corrective actions in collaboration with laboratory leadership and clinical partners to improve quality and patient experience

**Leadership, Training and Competency:**

* Directly supervise a growing phlebotomy team and workflow assigned to supported care settings
* Develop and manage staff schedules to ensure adequate coverage
* Monitor attendance, performance expectations, and service reliability
* Complete performance evaluations and provide coaching, counseling, and corrective action
* Promote a professional, respectful, and service‑oriented workforce that represents the laboratory appropriately
* Manage contingency coverage plans either through backup phlebotomist or designated vendors as necessary
* Ensure all phlebotomy staff receive appropriate initial and ongoing training to perform safely and independently in supported care environments
* Oversee orientation and competency assessment in specimen collection techniques, patient identification, infection prevention, professionalism, and laboratory policies
* Maintain required training and competency documentation
* Provide remedial training as needed to address performance or compliance gaps. Serve as a technical and procedural resource to staff

**Collaboration and Communication:**

* Serve as the primary laboratory contact for phlebotomy‑related service issues within supported environments
* Collaborate with laboratory leadership, providers, nursing representatives, patient access, information systems, and logistics teams to support accurate ordering, specimen handling, transport, and result reporting
* Communicate laboratory expectations, policies, and operational updates clearly to phlebotomy staff. Address service concerns promptly to maintain trust and service continuity

**Required Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree preferred
* Phlebotomy certification preferred
* Minimum 3–5 years of phlebotomy experience
* Prior supervisory or leadership experience required
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and customer service skills
* Ability to lead teams working independently across multiple care environments
* Knowledge of laboratory specimen collection standards and regulatory requirements
* Advanced understanding of Patient Experience & Professional Conduct
* Deep knowledge of Phlebotomy Quality & Safety
* Strong leadership acumen
* Highly motivated and collaborative individual
* Must be willing to travel to client sites as necessary
* Ability to pivot direction quickly
* As needed, may be required to travel to client locations for initial launch as well as ongoing compliance audits as necessary

#### **Compensation:**

* $75,000-$100,000

**Benefits:**  
  
As an Ascend Clinical employee, you will become part of a company that has received national recognition as a great place to work. We offer excellent full-time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid holidays and vacation, personal days, and dental and vision options.  
  
Ascend is an Equal Opportunity Employer - M/F/Disabled/Veteran

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Application deadline: Oct 20, 2026  
  
Amazon One Medical is a human-centered, technology-powered primary care organization committed to making high-quality healthcare more accessible, affordable, and convenient for all. We care for patients through a national network of more than 200 medical offices across 20+ U.S. markets, along with 24/7 on-demand virtual services. Our membership model supports both individual members and employees at over 7,000 companies. Since going public in 2020, Amazon One Medical has continued to grow, innovate, and advance our mission. We are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive team and fostering a collaborative environment focused on delivering exceptional care to our patients, providers, and partners.  
  
As we continue expanding and transforming the primary care experience, we are looking for energized leaders to support the people, processes, and technology that make One Medical unique. The Virtual Medical Team (VMT) delivers round-the-clock care nationwide in partnership with our in-office providers, ensuring a smooth and consistent patient experience no matter where members are. Reporting to the Virtual Care Operations Leader, the VMT Operations Manager will work in partnership with Senior Virtual Medical Directors to drive key business outcomes and support teams of Registered Nurses (RNs) in delivering high-quality, affordable care.  
  
You are a strong communicator who knows how to motivate teams and guide them toward shared goals. You are comfortable using both qualitative and quantitative insights to inform your decisions, and you take a thoughtful, holistic approach when introducing new workflows that improve the patient and provider experience. You can balance big-picture strategy with day-to-day operational needs, and you are passionate about healthcare innovation and building the future of virtual primary care.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Record, analyze, and monitor performance metrics to identify process and performance gaps across the VMT NP/PA organization
* Create intervention plans that address national, regional, or individual gaps
* Partner with Virtual Medical Directors on quarterly priorities for new rollouts, making strategic trade-offs with business objectives
* Visualize and present data-driven insights with progress reports to senior leadership, serve as VMT Operations spokesperson to frontline teams
* Own team initiatives, including project plan management, leading cross-functional meetings, escalating roadblocks, and crafting communication strategies
* Independently manage complex databases of rosters, schedules, and medical licenses using advanced spreadsheet data analysis and automation
* Utilize patient demand forecasts to make both real-time and long-term staffing determinations for each region, state, and license type, and team
* Design provider schedules in partnership with the Workforce Management team and the Flex Labor Manager, balancing patient demand with provider experience

  
A day in the life  
Your day will be dynamic and purpose-driven, focusing on supporting remote medical providers and optimizing patient care processes. You'll collaborate closely with Virtual Medical Directors, analyze performance metrics, and develop strategies that enhance both provider effectiveness and patient satisfaction. Each day brings opportunities to innovate, problem-solve, and make meaningful contributions to healthcare accessibility.  
  
About the team  
We are a passionate group of healthcare professionals committed to reimagining primary care. Our Virtual Medical Team operates nationwide, providing comprehensive care through innovative technology and a patient-first approach. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and a shared mission of making quality healthcare more convenient and inclusive.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* 2+ years navigating complex policy, process, and people-related organizational dynamics
* Proven expertise in advanced data manipulation using Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP and IMPORTRANGE functionality, and SQL queries
* Experience with analytics tools, preferably with focus on forecasting and staffing

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau), or experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document

**Overview of Job Function:**

The Manager, Operations will be responsible for the overall Supply Chain Management including interfacing with business functions, procurement, sales, support, quality management and new product engineering. The role will manage day-to-day operations including forecasting material planning, warehousing, inventory management, distribution, customer services, and support. The role will manage relationships with suppliers, contractors and third-party service providers to the operations group. The manager also will oversee the entire order cycle and ensure sustainable operations and customer satisfaction. This role is a blend of primarily managing external supply chain operations, while also providing people leadership internally to operations specialists.

  

**Principal Duties and Essential Responsibilities:**

* Liaise with leadership and business functions to drive operational activities and support business objectives.
* Evaluate overall performance by gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data and metrics.
* Direct inbound or outbound logistics operations, such as transportation optimization, warehouse activities, safety performance, or logistics quality management.
* Manage the daily fulfillment of customer shipments by working with Verint’s third party logistics service providers.
* Coordinate and communicate with planning, production, shipping, and procurement to meet order requirements and set priorities to achieve on-time delivery and maximize inventory.
* Regularly evaluate the efficiency of business procedures according to organizational objectives and identify/implement improvements.
* Own decisions and risks mitigators to execute on competing priorities and monitor specific supply chain-based Key Performance Measurement Matrix such as OTD (On Time Delivery), and MTTR (Mean Timer to Repair).
* Manage relationships and monitor agreements with external partners/vendors.
* Create policies or procedures for end-to-end supply chain activities.
* Plan and/or implement material flow management systems to meet production requirements.
* Analyze all aspects of corporate logistics to determine the most cost-effective, productive, accurate or timelines objectives of transporting product or supplies.
* Implement specific customer requirements, such as internal reporting or customized transportation metrics.
* Monitor product import/export processes to ensure compliance with regulatory or legal requirements.
* Negotiate transportation rates or services.
* Negotiate with suppliers or customers to improve supply chain efficiency or sustainability.
* Plan and implement improvements to internal or external logistics systems or processes.
* Recommend new or improved technology, such as automated systems.
* Develop risk management programs to ensure continuity of supply in emergency scenarios.
* Collaborate with other departments to integrate logistics with business systems or processes, such as sales, order management, accounting, customer support, product, NPI (New Product Introduction), and quality.
* Direct or coordinate comprehensive logistical or reverse logistical functions for product life cycles, including acquisition, distribution, internal allocation, delivery, recycling, reuse, or final disposal of resources.
* Conduct or review environmental audits for logistics activities, such as storage, distribution, or transportation.
* Lead a team of operations specialists to execute these responsibilities with your guidance.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* B.S. in Industrial engineering, Operations, Logistics or other related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum of 6 years’ experience in Hardware Operations & Supply chain and at least 4 years of leadership experience in a manufacturing or supply chain environment.
* Excellent analytical skills, experience with self-service BI reporting.
* Understanding of statistics, operation research and optimization of transportation networks.
* Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
* Strong communication skills and effectively presents information to leaders, employees, and customers.
* Ability to work independently and handle multiple projects.
* Driven, positive, and effective leader.
* Strong process orientation and developmental skills.
* Flexible working hours to accommodate a global operations organization.
* Successful completion of a background screening process including, but not limited to, employment verifications, criminal search, OFAC, SS Verification, as well as credit and drug screening, where applicable and in accordance with federal and local regulations.

#### **HR Operations Coordinator**

#### **About National Quality Systems**

National Quality Systems (NQS) is a healthcare SaaS company headquartered in Winter Park, Florida. NQS builds and supports clinical registry platforms serving trauma, burn, and emergency general surgery programs across the United States. Our platforms connect clinical outcomes with operational and financial performance data, helping healthcare organizations improve patient care and program performance. NQS is a remote-first company committed to building scalable systems, a high-performance culture, and a strong employee experience.

#### **Position Summary**

The HR Operations Coordinator supports HR operations, payroll processing, and general administrative functions across NQS. This role serves as a key operational resource for NQS executive leadership, ensuring HR processes, payroll activities, and company logistics are executed accurately and on time. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple functional areas in a fast-moving, remote environment. This is a fully remote position with occasional travel required.

Key Responsibilities

#### **HR Operations**

* Assist with drafting offer letters, employment agreements, and other HR documents for review and approval by executive leadership
* Support the onboarding process for new employees including coordination of background checks, Paychex Flex setup, I9 documentation, and prestart communications
* Maintain and organize employee files in SharePoint and NQS HR systems in compliance with recordkeeping requirements
* Support employee recognition activities and internal HR communications
* Assist with performance management administration including scheduling review cycles and tracking completion in Paychex Flex
* Support compliance activities including EVerify, employment eligibility documentation, and audit preparation
* Assist with HR policy documentation, SOPs, and internal process updates as directed

#### **Payroll and Tax Coordination**

* Process and administer payroll in Paychex Flex on a scheduled basis, ensuring accuracy of hours, deductions, and compensation data
* Support multistate payroll tax compliance by coordinating with the company's external accounting firm and legal support to ensure state tax registrations and nexus obligations are tracked and addressed
* Assist with new state registration processes as NQS expands its remote workforce footprint
* Identify and escalate payroll discrepancies or compliance concerns to executive leadership
* Maintain payroll records and support documentation for internal and external audits

#### **Administrative and Planning Support**

* Coordinate logistics for company inperson meetings and travel including RFP coordination for venues, hotel blocks, and travel arrangements
* Support calendar coordination for executive leadership as needed
* Assist with administrative tasks and special projects assigned by executive leadership
* Support preparation and organization of internal documents, presentations, and company communications
* Assist with vendor coordination and followup related to HR and operational service providers

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in HR operations, payroll administration, or a comparable administrative support role
* Demonstrated experience processing payroll in an HRIS or payroll platform
* Working knowledge of multistate payroll concepts and tax compliance fundamentals
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously
* High attention to detail and accuracy in document preparation and data entry
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and SharePoint
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to handle confidential employee information with discretion and professionalism
* Legal authorization to work in the United States

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Paychex Flex or a comparable HRIS platform
* Familiarity with multistate employment compliance and state tax registration processes
* Prior experience supporting HR operations in a remote or distributed workforce environment
* Experience coordinating travel logistics or vendor RFP processes
* Exposure to healthcare or SaaS industry environments
* PHR, SHRMCP, or comparable HR certification is a plus

#### **Work Environment**

This is a fully remote position within the United States. Occasional travel for company meetings, in-person planning sessions, or other organizational events may be required.

#### **Compensation**

The anticipated salary range for this position is $80,000 to $85,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications. NQS offers a competitive benefits package including health insurance, paid time off, and additional benefits as outlined in the company's benefit plan documents.

Compliance, Legal, and Employment Statements

#### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

National Quality Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

#### **At-Will Employment**

Employment with National Quality Systems is at will. This job description is not a contract of employment. NQS may modify the duties, responsibilities, or requirements of this role at any time based on organizational needs and at its discretion.

Confidentiality and Data Security Requirements

This position may involve access to confidential and protected patient information. All employees must comply with HIPAA regulations and adhere to company policies, SOC 2 requirements, and industry standards related to data privacy, security, and proper handling of protected health information. Compliance with all NQS privacy and security protocols, including practices consistent with HITRUST frameworks, is mandatory.

#### **Reasonable Accommodation**

Applicants who require a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the application process, or employees who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of their role, should contact the NQS Human Resources team.

#### **Pre-Employment Requirements**

Employment may be contingent upon successful completion of required background checks, verification of eligibility to work in the United States, and any additional pre-employment screenings as required by NQS.

#### **Other Duties**

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified at any time to reflect changing business needs. Additional duties may be assigned as required.

Point Broadband and Clearwave Fiber are affiliated companies operating as part of a combined organization. This opportunity is a Point Broadband position, and candidates selected for hire will be employed by Point Broadband under Point Broadband’s benefit plans, payroll, and employment policies.
  
  
Network Operations Specialist
  
Remote - Successful candidate must live in a state in which Point Broadband operates (AL, FL, GA, IL, KS, MD, MI, NY, OH, TN, TX, or VA) #LI-remote
  
  
**Summary:**  
This position is responsible for monitoring and maintaining Point Broadband's network infrastructure to ensure uninterrupted service for customers. This role includes real-time monitoring, troubleshooting, responding to incidents, collaborating with both internal and external teams, and proactively addressing potential issues to maintain operational excellence and deliver superior customer experiences.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**  
Essential duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to those listed below:
  
  

* Adhere fully to all policies and guidelines of Point Broadband and the Network Operations Center, including the Point Broadband Value System and NOC Core Values.
* Utilize Network Management System (NMS) tools and alarm notifications to oversee the network infrastructure, including routers, switches, circuits, and backbone connections.
* Respond promptly to alerts and incidents to minimize downtime. Create tickets to track all outages while adhering to the Incident Management Process.
* Identify and troubleshoot network performance issues, outages, and possible security threats. Escalate any outages to the correct fix agent(s) once identified and escalate critical issues to NOC leadership, engineers, or relevant departments as needed.
* Perform initial diagnostics of network-related issues and coordinate resolutions with engineering teams, field technicians, and customer support.
* Provide technical support and coordination for network maintenance, upgrades, and migrations.
* Maintain detailed documentation of incidents, actions taken, and resolutions within the internal ticketing system (tell the full story of each issue and resolution).
* Analyze network traffic patterns and performance metrics to proactively identify potential issues or areas for improvement.
* Assist in configuring, testing, and deploying new network hardware and software solutions.
* Support routine maintenance activities such as firmware updates, hardware replacements, system patches, or server reboots per department policies.
* Work closely with field technicians to support on-premises troubleshooting efforts.
* Assist in creating and maintaining department documentation such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and market-specific guides.
* Research updates for core documentation related to new markets, cabinets, circuits, or decommissioned equipment.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to carry out each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities required for the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
  
  
**Education & Experience:**  

* High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate’s degree or higher in IT, Network Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field preferred.
* CCNA, CompTIA Network+, JNCIA, or equivalent certifications preferred.
* 2+ years in network operations, IT support, or telecommunications.
* Hands-on experience with fiber-to-the-premise (FTTP), fixed wireless networks, and enterprise network environments is a plus.

**Technical Skills:**  

* Proficiency in MS Office Suite, CLI-based troubleshooting tools, and network monitoring software.
* Experienced in incident management, using ticketing systems, and implementing service restoration processes.
* Knowledge of Layer 2/3 networking, BGP, OSPF, and SNMP-based monitoring tools.
* Familiar with network security best practices and effective troubleshooting methodologies.

**Soft Skills:**  

* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities to effectively engage with both technical and non-technical teams.
* Capability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-stress environment while maintaining attention to detail.
* Willingness to work nights, weekends, holidays, and be on-call as needed.

**Physical Demands/Working Conditions:**  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job the employee is:
  
  

* Required to talk, hear, and communicate effectively.
* Regularly required to answer phones, be on bridge calls or Zoom/Teams meetings, and take detailed notes during an investigation.
* Required to use hands to type, handle objects and paperwork.
* Required to reach and hold on to items at chest level or reach above the shoulder.
* Required to use close vision and be able to focus and to see colors.
* The employee generally works in an indoor office environment.
* Ability to work in a high-stress, high-demand environment is expected.

**Benefits:**

Highest level of technical expertise. Operates under minimum supervision and has the ability to make independent decisions. Demonstrates the highest level of proficiency in one modality to the level of knowledge of the manufacture. Has ability to share knowledge regarding area of specialization across area or region. Strong planning and organization skills. Excellent verbal, written, communication and presentation skills

The role of an individual contributor within the organization focuses on completing specific tasks and projects; contributing directly through their skills and expertise. **What’s in it for you**

**What you’ll bring**

* Considerable knowledge of electronic circuitry and technical aspects of the operation, repair and maintenance of electronic equipment.
* Substantial knowledge of basic anatomy, physiology, and medical terminology.
* Ability to interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and illustrated parts drawings of biomedical instrumentation and skill in testing electronic equipment as well as in manual dexterity, hand-to-eye coordination, and color vision.
* Formal training and preferred experience servicing clinical equipment.
* Experience effectively repairing, maintaining and calibrating clinical devices specific to hospital decontamination, Steris or ASP sterilizers, and equipment sterilization.

* Excellent communication, customer service and time management skills.

**Requirements**

**What we offer**

ff817d29c6b5d1970c19.description:
HMA is the premier third-party health plan administrator across the PNW and beyond. We relentlessly deliver on our promise to provide medium to large-size employers with customized health plans. We offer various high-quality, affordable healthcare plan options supported with best-in-class customer service.

We are proud to say that for three years, HMA has been chosen as a ‘Washington’s Best Workplaces’ by our Staff and PSBJ™. Our vision, ‘Proving What’s Possible in Healthcare™,’ and our values, People First!, Be Extraordinary, Work Courageously, Own It, and Win Together, shape our culture, influence our decisions, and drive our results.

What we are looking for: We are always searching for unique people to add to our team. We only hire people that care deeply about others, thrive in evolving environments, gain satisfaction from being part of a team, are motivated by tackling complex challenges, are courageous enough to share ideas, action-oriented, resilient, and results-driven.

What you can expect: You can expect an inclusive, flexible, and fun culture, comprehensive salary, pay transparency, benefits, and time off package with plenty of personal development and growth opportunities. If you are looking for meaningful work, a clear purpose, high standards, work/life balance, and the ability to contribute to something important, find out more about us at: https://www.accesshma.com/

**How YOU will make a Difference:**

Join HMA during one of the most dynamic times of the year as a Contract Operations Support Specialist, where your attention to detail and organizational skills will help power critical business operations across Client Success, Claims, and Care Management. As HMA supports group implementations, annual renewals, and member administration activities, you'll serve as a key operational partner, ensuring data integrity, auditing important benefits information, coordinating ID card processes, and supporting teams with essential administrative functions. If you enjoy fast-paced work, collaborating across departments, and being the person who keeps things running smoothly behind the scenes, this role offers an opportunity to make an immediate impact while gaining exposure to multiple areas of healthcare administration and operations.

**What YOU will do:**

Client Implementation Support

* Assist with new group implementations by entering and validating client and member information in internal systems.
* Ensure prior authorizations (PAs) and related data are accurately transferred and maintained during group implementation activities.
* Support implementation teams with administrative and data management tasks to ensure smooth onboarding of new clients.

Renewal Administration Support

* Enter renewal information and supporting documents into CRM and operational systems.
* Maintain accurate records and ensure renewal documentation is complete and properly stored.
* Coordinate with Client Success teams to support annual renewal processes and deadlines.

Audit and Quality Assurance

* Review and audit Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) documentation to ensure benefit details and funding amounts align with system configuration and renewal documentation.
* Verify accuracy of entered data and identify discrepancies for correction.
* Perform quality checks on client and member information across multiple systems.
* Maintain documentation of audit findings and assist with resolution efforts.

ID Card and Member Administration Coordination

* Audit ID card requests submitted by Account Managers to ensure requests are complete and accurate prior to submission to Technical Operations.
* Review supporting documentation and system entries for completeness and compliance with established procedures.
* Coordinate communication and follow-up regarding ID card production and distribution activities.

General Administrative Support

* Provide operational and administrative assistance to Client Success, Claims, and Care Management teams as needed.
* Manage data entry projects, document processing, record updates, and other administrative tasks.
* Support special projects and seasonal workload demands across multiple business units.
* Maintain confidentiality and compliance with all company policies and regulatory requirements.

  
**Requirements**

**Knowledge, Experience and Attributes:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree preferred.
* 5+ year of administrative, operational support, data entry, customer service, healthcare administration, or related experience.
* 3+ years of experience working with databases, CRM platforms, or business systems.
* 5+ years of experience with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive member and client information.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify data inconsistencies and errors.
* Previous experience in healthcare administration, health insurance, TPA operations, or employee benefits.
* Experience supporting enrollment, implementation, renewals, claims administration, or care management functions.
* Familiarity with auditing, quality assurance, or data validation processes.
* Knowledge of member eligibility, ID card processes, or benefit administration is preferred.

 **Benefits**

**Compensation:**

Compensation for this contract role ranges from $27–$33 per hour, and varies dependent on geography, skills, experience, education, and other job or market-related factors.

*Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information are accurate as of this posting date. HMA reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.*

**How we Support your Work, Life, and Wellness Goals**

At HMA, we believe in recognizing and celebrating the achievements of our dedicated staff. We offer flexibility to work schedules that support people in all time zones across the US, ensuring a healthy work-life balance. Employees have the option to work remotely or enjoy the amenities of our renovated office located just outside Seattle with free parking, gym, and a multitude of refreshments. Our performance management program is designed to elevate career growth opportunities, fostering a collaborative work culture where every team member can thrive. We also prioritize having fun together by hosting in person events throughout the year including an annual all hands, summer picnic, trivia night, and a holiday party.

*We hire people from across the US (excluding the state of Hawaii and the cities of Los Angeles and San Francisco.)*

*HMA requires a background screen prior to employment.*

*Protected Health Information (PHI) Access* *Healthcare Management Administrators (HMA); employees may encounter protected health information (PHI) in the regular course of their work. All PHI shall be used and disclosed on a need-to-know-basis and according to HMA’s standard policies and procedures.*

**HMA is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

For more information about HMA, visit https://www.accesshma.com/
